raw.description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.

About the company:

The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.
  • Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.
  • Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.
  • Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with brand managers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders to align demand forecasts with marketing, promotions, and sales strategies.
  • Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.
  • Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.
  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software
  • Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus
  • This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote and full-time role.
  • Paid time off.
  • Yearly bonuses.
  • Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.
  • Competitive and timely salary.
  • Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.
  • Dynamic, creative work environments.
  • Flexible schedule.

raw.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - Accelerated Spark Applications
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years.
raw.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer for the Apache Spark Acceleration group. GPU accelerated data processing has moved from proof of concept to production deployments. Enterprises now recognize the need for accelerated computing to handle large data processing needs. Multi-node GPU deployments reduce cloud computing costs and lower the latency of batch ETL workloads. At NVIDIA, we accelerate Apache Spark with an open source plugin that speeds up Spark applications on GPUs without code changes, and our cuDF Spark library is integrated with AWS EMR, Databricks, Google Dataproc, Oracle Cloud Data Flow, Bytedance Volcengine, Tencent Cloud and Cloudera. This role is on the team that runs that acceleration as a handled Spark service inside NVIDIA. The service accomplishes production data pipelines for NVIDIA’s internal data platform at thousands of jobs an hour on Kubernetes and AWS, under a customer SLA. It packages the cuDF Spark plugin and a CPU/GPU workload router into an API-based service built on Spark Connect, Kyuubi, Helm and Flux. You will work across all three layers: the service, the GPU Spark runtime, and the router.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Design, build and operate hosted Spark service control plane on Kubernetes: the Java REST API, the Spark Connect runner, Kyuubi, and deployment using Helm charts and Flux
  • Own code review for one or more services end to end and keep them releasable on the release train
  • Extend the cuDF Spark runtime and the CPU/GPU workload router in Scala and Java, including interoperability with Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg and Unity Catalog
  • Investigate production failures on clusters running more than a thousand concurrent jobs together with the customer team and upstream library teams, and drive fixes to closure
  • Instrument metrics, dashboards and alerts; take part in the on-call rotation and keep the runbooks current
  • Provide recommendations and feedback to teams regarding decisions surrounding topics such as infrastructure, continuous integration and testing strategy

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 9+ years of experience in software development
  • Strong distributed-systems fundamentals and proficiency in Java or Scala, plus C++ or Python
  • Hands-on experience operating services on Kubernetes, on-premise or cloud
  • Experience owning or reviewing a long-lived server: REST front ends, proxies or request routers, JDBC or Thrift services
  • Experience supporting enterprise or internal production customers, including on-call
  • Experience using AI tools in software development

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Apache Spark internals, Spark Connect, or Kyuubi
  • Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg or Unity Catalog integration work
  • GPU data processing with cuDF, or CUDA experience
  • Significant contributions to data platform projects committed to collaboration and shared development (Apache Spark, Velox, Presto, Apache Arrow, Apache DataFusion)

Widely Is considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 23, 2026.

raw.description:
We are hiring an experienced Klaviyo Specialist for our client, a growing retention email marketing agency that has generated over $30 million in revenue for subscription eCommerce brands.

This role is for someone who knows Klaviyo inside out, has experience managing multiple agency accounts, and can independently execute high-performing email campaigns and flows.

A Day in This Role

You start your day inside Klaviyo, reviewing campaigns and automated flows across your client accounts.

One brand needs its subscription cancellation flow updated. Another has an abandoned cart flow that needs testing, while a third has a campaign scheduled to go live.

You check the segmentation, triggers, links, and tracking to make sure everything is working before launch.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to keep campaigns moving.

You end the day knowing your work has helped multiple eCommerce brands run stronger retention email programs.

Must-Have Requirements

Please apply only if you meet all five requirements:

  1. 2+ years of hands-on Klaviyo experience working with eCommerce brands generating $1M+ in monthly revenue.

  2. Subscription eCommerce experience, including cancellation and downgrade flows, and integrations with Skio, Loop, Recharge, Ordergroove, or similar platforms.

  3. Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously. Freelance-only or in-house-only experience is not sufficient.

  4. Experience managing 5+ accounts independently while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  5. Strong written English (B2+ minimum) and the ability to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous team.

What You'll Do

  • Build, manage, and optimize Klaviyo flows, including Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase, Winback, and subscription retention flows.

  • Build, schedule, and launch email campaigns across multiple client accounts.

  • Perform pre-launch QA, checking segmentation, triggers, links, rendering, and tracking.

  • Monitor deliverability, maintain list hygiene, and run A/B tests to improve performance.

  • Collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to deliver campaigns accurately and on time.

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You have general email marketing experience but limited hands-on Klaviyo expertise.

  • You've only worked as a freelancer or in-house marketer without agency experience.

  • You haven't worked with subscription eCommerce brands or built cancellation and downgrade flows.

  • You need constant supervision or struggle to manage multiple client accounts independently.

  • You frequently miss deadlines, overlook campaign details, or struggle with written communication.

Why Join?

  • Work with established seven-figure subscription eCommerce brands.

  • Enjoy a fully remote role with autonomy over your daily schedule.

  • Join a small, experienced team focused on delivering measurable results.

  • Grow your career with a clear path from Klaviyo Specialist to Client Success Manager.

Ready to Apply?

If you have proven Klaviyo agency experience, understand subscription eCommerce, and can confidently manage multiple accounts without constant supervision, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now.

At Tectu, you can make a real impact! As a Data Engineer you will play a lead role in delivering data and business strategies, solutions and processes to support the data oriented projects. The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering cutting edge solutions to support the changing business needs and technology landscape. You will be working closely with others on our Product and Engineering teams to define and deliver these solutions.

If you are data obsessed, passionate about technology, self-motivated and a disciplined freelancer, we would love to speak with you. The ideal candidate has both a willingness and desire to work in a dynamic environment, is able to apply Agile methodologies in day-to-day activities, and who enjoys working both independently with little oversight and in a team environment.

About the Role

At Tectu, we work with various customers, providing advanced tech solutions to solve different problems and needs. As a Data Engineer at Tectu, your day will most likely vary according to which projects youre involved in, but generally youll be performing the following activities:

  • Owning major projects from inception to production deployment, shipping at a rapid pace

  • Architecting, designing and developing simple, yet flexible solutions for a variety of customers

  • Designing and building data infrastructure such as data ingestion, pipelines, warehouses, and data lakes that are efficient architectures and capable of storing and analyzing large quantities of data

  • Solving challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal ETL patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources.

  • Recommending and implementing ways to improve data reliability, efficiency, cost and quality

  • Participating in defining data strategy and capabilities roadmap

  • Contributing to team-wide efforts - code reviews, design reviews, technical decisions, and mentoring others

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing and data lake platforms

  • Strong proficiency of SQL and Python

  • Experience in data analytics, data modeling, ETL/ELT, data integration and orchestration (e.g. Airflow) and processing of structured and unstructured data.

  • Experience in a variety of big data technologies such as AWS EMR (Spark) and Athena (Presto)

  • Experience with DWH solutions like AWS Redshift, BigQuery, Clickhouse

  • Experience with latest cloud technologies of one of the biggest vendors (AWS is an advantage)

  • A proven track record of owning and delivering tasks and projects on time

Soft Skills

  • Strong work ethic and strong core values (honesty, integrity, creativity)

  • Sense of urgency, ownership mindset, and customer focus

  • Innovative problem solver who takes initiative never stops thinking about ways to improve

  • Ability to self-learn new skills and technologies

Advantage

  • BS in highly-quantitative field (Analytics, Computer Science, Mathematics, EE) is preferred

  • Experience designing data systems from scratch

  • Data driven mindset

  • Able to create and communicate the 'big picture' in a clear way.

  • Experience with data testing and data ops tools

  • Experience with writing tested code as part of development lifecycle (e.g. Unit, Integration, API)

raw.description:
Client Success Manager

Company Overview

Waterfield Tech helps companies plan, deploy, and run the Customer Experience (CX) stack and operation as one system – combining tech and talent with shared KPI accountability so customer outcomes and economics improve together.

We value our people—their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to Client satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls.

Position Summary

The Client Success Manager (CSM) plays a central role in ensuring that Waterfield’s clients achieve meaningful, measurable outcomes from their investment in our solutions. This role is responsible for driving customer adoption, value realization, and long-term account growth.

The CSM serves as the primary day-to-day point of contact for client stakeholders and acts as the quarterback of the ongoing customer experience. This includes overseeing and coordinating support activities, ensuring issues are addressed in a timely manner, and serving as a trusted escalation point when needed.

By maintaining a deep understanding of each client’s environment, goals, and challenges, the CSM ensures alignment between client needs and Waterfield’s capabilities. In partnership with account leadership and delivery teams, the CSM drives proactive engagement, manages risk, and identifies opportunities to expand Waterfield’s impact within the account.

This role requires a balance of relationship management, operational discipline, and strategic thinking, with a strong focus on delivering outcomes—not just managing activity.

This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys building relationships, driving outcomes, and helping clients grow through technology.

This role requires travel as needed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with key client stakeholders
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison and go-to resource for assigned clients
  • Oversee and coordinate ongoing support and service activities, ensuring timely execution and follow-through
  • Act as an escalation point for client issues, driving resolution
  • Develop and execute client success plans aligned to customer goals and desired outcomes
  • Drive adoption of Waterfield solutions by identifying gaps and recommending actions to increase value realization
  • Monitor account health, including customer sentiment, usage trends, and operational performance, and proactively identify risks
  • Ensure account team is informed of key developments, risks, and opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to expand Waterfield’s footprint by uncovering unmet needs and areas for growth
  • Support and contribute to business reviews (MBRs/QBRs), including insights, performance data, and recommendations
  • Provide input into renewal planning by ensuring customers are realizing value and highlighting changes in the customer environment
  • Coordinate across delivery, support, and partner teams to ensure a consistent and high-quality customer

Qualifications

  • 3–7+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to connect technical solutions to business value
  • Experience managing multiple clients
  • Preferred: CX, CCaaS, SaaS, or managed services

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit for long periods of time.
  • Normal or corrected vision and hearing to work with others in person and video conference.

Waterfield Tech is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Waterfield Tech believes that all persons are entitled to equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate against its Employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, citizenship status, disability, protected medical condition, military status, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy extends to all aspects of our employment practices including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, discipline, promotion, transfers, compensation, benefits, leaves of absence, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

raw.description:
Job Summary:We are seeking a seasoned Senior Full Stack Solution Architect to join our innovative team. As a Senior Full Stack Solution Architect, you will be responsible for designing and implementing end-to-end solutions that meet the complex business needs of our organization. You will leverage your extensive experience in both front-end and back-end technologies to architect scalable, secure, and high-performance systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, deep technical expertise, and a passion for driving innovation and excellence.

Responsibilities:

  1. Lead the design and architecture of full-stack solutions, spanning front-end, back-end, and database layers, to address business requirements and technical challenges.
  2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements, define technical specifications, and translate them into scalable and maintainable architectures.
  3. Evaluate and recommend appropriate technologies, frameworks, and tools to support the development and deployment of robust and efficient solutions.
  4. Design and implement microservices-based architectures, API integrations, and distributed systems to enable seamless communication and interoperability between components.
  5. Architect and implement cloud-native solutions on platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, leveraging services like AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, or Google Cloud Functions.
  6. Establish best practices, coding standards, and guidelines for software development, ensuring adherence to architectural principles, scalability, security, and performance requirements.
  7. Mentor and coach junior architects and developers, providing technical guidance, reviewing designs and code, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  8. Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate deployment pipelines, implement infrastructure as code, and ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of production systems.
  9. Conduct architectural reviews and assessments, identify areas for optimization and improvement, and drive initiatives to enhance system reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  10. Stay abreast of emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in full-stack development and architecture, and proactively evaluate their potential impact on our solutions and processes.

Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert) is a plus.
  2. Proven experience as a Full Stack Solution Architect, with at least 8 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing complex software systems.
  3. Deep understanding of software architecture principles, design patterns, and best practices, with expertise in both front-end (e.g., JavaScript, Angular, React) and back-end (e.g., Node.js, Java, Python) technologies.
  4. Extensive experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and proficiency in designing and implementing cloud-native solutions.
  5. Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  6. Expertise in relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), data modeling, and database optimization techniques.
  7. Hands-on experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, configuration management), and familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  8. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  9. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyze trade-offs between architectural choices and make recommendations based on business priorities and constraints.
  10. Demonstrated leadership abilities, with a track record of leading cross-functional teams, driving architectural initiatives, and delivering successful solutions on time and within budget.

raw.description:
Company description

Netbank is a start-up fintech led bank, focused on the under-served. Its model is to:

  • Partner with Fintechs, banks and non-bank lenders, who have existing client networks or are looking to enter the Philippines
  • Allow these partners to sign-up clients, for an origination fee, booked on Netbanks balance sheet. Netbank would provide:
  • Loans to clients, so the partners can grow without raising additional capital
  • Deposit accounts for clients, serviced by the partner (on a white-label basis)
  • Payment services to clients, including ACH payments, access to cards, payment to wallets, etc.
  • Technology services to the partners, allowing them more efficient processing and better client satisfaction

Netbank Virtual is a product area of Netbank, offering banking as a service via APIs to local fintech and international fintech looking to enter the market. It expects to offer services in:

  • Disburse funds: Payments via ACH, payments to wallets, payments to cash.
  • Collect funds: Receive funds from the above channels
  • Open transaction accounts / wallets
  • Open loan accounts.

Netbank will offer segment specific solutions, aiming to roll-out products to a pilot client and then a range of similar clients.

Responsibilities:

This position is a member of the team responsible for services to lenders.

The FLDG Loans Manager is responsible for product and business development for cash loans, mostly under FLDG.

The steps in product development will be:

  • Definition of product design to understand the data that can be gathered from the platform / payroll provider
  • Understanding of the repayment process to ensure these loans are self-liquidating
  • Assessment of size of loan partner, growth opportunity
  • Identification of additional data that may be available on the end client
  • Definition of data sources that can be used to assess creditworthiness.
  • Creation of legal agreements / specific processes to reduce credit risk
  • Definition of process design (document sharing, etc.)
  • Legal and contractual work with the platform / with the borrower
  • Product definition (term, tenor, etc.)

The steps in partner development will be:

  • Understand the product that Netbank can provide to end clients.
  • Listen carefully to the situation of these lenders and align our sales strategy to their situation
  • Describe the solution and work with the partners as they develop the solution. Explain the regulation, the options, the financial implications.
  • Provide advisory services to potential partners, to accelerate the on-boarding process and prove our culture of relentless implementation
  • Commercial negotiation
  • Support clients through implementation. Work closely with the clients to on-board them.

The steps in partner optimisation will be:

  • Identify product enhancements which ensure we meet the full needs of our end clients around lending products.
  • Identify causes of losses and ways to reduce these losses through credit risk mitigations
  • Identify additional products to sell to the end clients, such as additional loans, accounts, insurance, etc.
  • Identify how we can support internal processes of partners, such as by implementing collection accounts, etc.

As with all solutions providers, the position holder will need to:

  • Deeply understand client needs for the proposed services and identify ways that Netbank can provide a product significantly better than the competition
  • Implement the product to achieve this differentiation, including ensuring the technical system capabilities can meet client requirement
  • Managing a highly professional sales and on-boarding process, which responds at the speed that Fintech demand, keeps partners fully informed through the implementation process.
  • Identify additional services which clients need and propose these to clients. Identify product gaps and identify technical partnerships and technology solutions that allow us to offer these services.

Metrics to monitor

  • Number of new partners signed up
  • Revenue generated within vehicle lending
  • Number of new products offered relevant for these partners

Required skills and qualifications

  • Industry awareness
  • Knowledge of Cash loans / consumer lending
  • Views on opportunities in the market, new opportunities, etc.
  • Business development skills.
  • Enjoy sales process
  • Confidence to proactively contact new clients
  • Empathy to understand needs of organizations
  • Creativity to identify best banking solutions
  • Creativity in banking product design
  • Apply existing best practices while being aware that existing practices in the Philippines may not be optimal.
  • Risk awareness
  • Ability to calculate / estimate expected loss rates and identify the required pricing
  • Ability to understand the profit implications of different pricing proposals
  • Identification of ways to predict losses (churn, etc.)
  • Awareness of collections processes and ways to get data to ensure collection
  • Innovation
  • Interest in new technologies / data sources that may allow Netbank to lower credit risk
  • Drive and impatience
  • Self-starter, following opportunities
  • Desire to move forward with projects and clients
  • Finding the fastest way to implement

Initial tasks

  • Complete the implementation with Sprout
  • Review international experience on ways to reduce credit risk. Input into Credit decisioning process.
  • Identify other partners able to provide data on employed individuals - focus on HRIS providers, etc.
  • Identify additional product components needed to implement with other providers, such as customer front-ends, splitting of client payment flows, apps / SDKs for providing end clients data on their loans, etc.

Role Title: Bluebook Citation Specialist (Law Students & Recent JDs)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $50–80/hour

You’ll need: Current or recent law school enrollment, hands-on Bluebook experience, and law journal or law review editing experience

Your tasks: Review citation-checking rubrics and build sample cite-checking tasks

Job Description

micro1 is engaging law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. If you’ve spent time cite-checking for a law review or journal, this is that skill applied to a new context. No prior AI experience is required — your Bluebook fluency and editorial judgment are what matter.

Scope of Work

  1. Review existing Bluebook and pincite grading rubrics, and flag rules that are unclear, incomplete, or would be applied inconsistently by different editors.
  2. Identify edge cases the rubrics don’t currently cover and recommend how they should be handled.
  3. Create sample cite-checking tasks: source material paired with citations containing realistic errors, along with the correct answer and an explanation of the rule involved.
  4. Build tasks across a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from straightforward formatting errors to subtle pincite and source-support problems.
  5. Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions.
  6. Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently.
  7. Deliver assigned work on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Current law student (2L, 3L) or recent JD graduate.
  2. Law review or law journal experience, ideally including a cite-checking or source-collection role.
  3. Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals.
  4. Able to explain why a citation is wrong, not just that it is — the reasoning matters as much as the correction.
  5. Careful and consistent across long sessions of detailed review work.
  6. Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines without close supervision.
  7. Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is a plus.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview— this is how we showcase your skills to the client
  3. Profile review by the hiring team
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

Role Title: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: United States, Remote

micro1 is engaging Certified Coding Specialists to contribute to a valued project focused on enhancing clinical coding accuracy and data quality. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and analyze inpatient medical records to ensure accurate ICD-10 and CPT coding in alignment with current guidelines and best practices.
  2. Review clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, and coding integrity.

  6. Enter AI-generated patient information into computerized inpatient and outpatient medical record databases.

  3. Access to up-to-date official ICD-10 and CPT coding books, as well as E&M guidelines.
  4. Currently working in medical coding, clinical documentation improvement, or a closely related documentation role
  5. Availability of at least 10 hours per week

Position: Social Media & Digital Marketing Specialist

Salary: Php 75,000 to Php 85,000

Working Hours: AU or NZ Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is a premier recruitment, workforce, and immigration group connecting skilled workers with life-changing employment opportunities across Australia and New Zealand.

Through its specialist divisions, the group of company supports employers across the construction, civil infrastructure, mining, and industrial sectors while empowering skilled Filipino tradespeople to access international career pathways. Operating across the Philippines, Australia, and New Zealand, the company seamlessly integrates international recruitment, workforce mobilisation, and visa expertise to deliver sustainable, long-term workforce solutions.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a highly creative, commercially minded, and proactive Social Media & Digital Marketing Specialist to take full ownership of the company's digital marketing presence.

Moving beyond basic content scheduling, you will build and execute a results-driven digital marketing strategy that generates meaningful business opportunities across two primary audiences:

  1. Australian Employers (B2B): Building brand awareness and driving qualified enquiries from construction, civil, mining, and infrastructure businesses seeking skilled labour solutions.
  2. Filipino Skilled Workers (B2C): Promoting international employment opportunities, establishing trust, and attracting qualified candidates seeking overseas career pathways in Australia and New Zealand.

Working directly with the Director, you will bridge strategic marketing vision with hands-on execution, transforming raw recruitment objectives into scalable digital campaigns.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Social Media Strategy & Brand Management

  • Formulate and implement a structured organic social media strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and emerging digital channels.
  • Transition the brand from ad hoc posting to a consistent, high-impact marketing framework.
  • Build and maintain comprehensive monthly content calendars aligned with core hiring drives and corporate growth goals.
  • Continuously audit platform metrics to refine positioning, grow audience reach, and maximize engagement.

2. End-to-End Content Creation

  • Produce professional, compelling copy and multimedia assets tailored specifically to Australian enterprise decision-makers and Filipino tradespeople.
  • Design high-converting social graphics, carousels, promotional collaterals, and short-form video content.
  • Showcase successful candidate placements, employer testimonials, trade opportunities, and immigration insights.
  • Maintain strict brand governance and visual consistency across every digital touchpoint.

3. Paid Advertising & Performance Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize performance marketing campaigns via Meta Ads Manager and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.
  • Architect targeted B2B lead generation campaigns reaching Australian construction firms, sub-contractors, and enterprise hiring managers.
  • Execute targeted candidate attraction campaigns to build talent pipelines of qualified Filipino tradespeople.
  • Perform A/B testing on ad copy, visual assets, and target demographics to lower CAC and elevate lead quality.
  • Track ROI, ROAS, and key performance indicators (KPIs), delivering strategic recommendations directly to leadership.

4. Employer & Candidate Marketing Collateral

  • Develop market-facing campaigns that articulate the company's value proposition to business owners and HR leaders.
  • Produce educational content detailing visa processes, cross-border recruitment pathways, and industry insights.
  • Monitor trade, construction, and migration trends to capitalize on emerging content opportunities.

5. Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Monitor multi-channel performance including traffic, lead conversion rates, audience growth, and engagement velocity.
  • Deliver regular data-driven performance updates and campaign analysis to senior leadership.
  • Proactively audit marketing systems to identify conversion bottlenecks and test innovative lead generation tactics.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum 3+ years of dedicated experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, or social media management.
  • Strategic Capability: Proven track record of developing and executing multi-channel marketing strategies from scratch.
  • Platform Mastery: Advanced working knowledge of LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Meta Business Suite. Hands-on experience with paid ad platforms (Meta Ads required; LinkedIn Ads strongly preferred).
  • Technical & Creative Toolkit: High proficiency with design, video, and management tools including Canva, CapCut, Meta Business Suite, and social media scheduling platforms.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with an acute ability to write professionally for Australian B2B executives and engagingly for candidate markets.
  • Analytical Mindset: Core understanding of digital marketing metrics, funnel optimization, B2B lead generation, and paid campaign performance analysis.
  • Work Style: Self-directed, highly organized, and comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment.

PREFERRED:

  • Prior digital marketing experience within recruitment, staffing, immigration, or workforce management sectors.
  • Direct exposure to Australian or New Zealand B2B markets.
  • Familiarity with the construction, trades, civil infrastructure, or mining verticals.
  • Previous experience marketing international career opportunities to Filipino professionals or tradespeople.
  • Demonstrated capability in running LinkedIn campaigns targeted at business owners, hiring managers, and enterprise decision-makers.
  • Working knowledge of email marketing tools, CRM platforms, and foundational SEO practices.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Strategic Ownership: A balanced mindset combining high-level marketing strategy with hands-on content execution.
  • Commercial Mindset: An understanding that marketing exists to build trust, generate qualified leads, and drive business growth.
  • Autonomous Drive: The confidence to lead initiatives, solve problems independently, and present fresh ideas to senior leadership without needing micromanagement.
  • Cultural Versatility: The nuance to communicate effectively with high-level corporate stakeholders in Australia/New Zealand while authentically connecting with skilled Filipino workers.
  • Accountability for Results: A commitment to measurable outcomes, continuous testing, and data-backed refinement.

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the US, delivering Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and technology solutions across multiple industries and countries worldwide. Our team uses people, technology and innovation to help organizations improve customer experience and business performance.

The ideal candidate will have a wide range of experience and proficiencies. Areas of the law regularly practiced include mergers/acquisitions, contracting and negotiations, consumer law, IP law, telecommunications law, insurance, regulatory adherence including US and foreign data privacy laws.

Strong oral and written presentation skills are required.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

-

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide legal support as needed by the General Counsel
  • Draft, review, and revise contracts and advise on contracts and other transactional agreements that are often subject to quick turnaround times, which could include procurement and services agreements, non-disclosure agreements, and other business documents.
  • Give accurate and timely counsel to the different internal business units and executives on a variety of legal topics.
  • Conducting legal research on a wide range of topics
  • Monitor applicable state and federal laws, decisional laws from other jurisdictions, and industry publications.
  • Maintain the highest standards of personal, professional, and ethical conduct and support the company's goals.
  • Clearly communicate policies and procedures to staff

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:

  • Juris Doctorate and membership in at least one U.S. State bar is required.
  • At least 2 full years of experience practicing law, with some portion of that experience encompassing most of the areas of law stated herein.
  • Excellent organizational skills, ability to manage multiple projects at once, follow through, and meet deadlines.
  • Proficient legal research and drafting skills, and use of Westlaw and PACER
  • Strong analytical skills/attention to detail.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Excel, Word & PowerPoint
  • Clear, concise and practical communication skills (both oral and written)
  • A solution-oriented and positive mindset that openly embraces change and stretches goals.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ever-changing, and high-pressure environment.
  • Reliable, ethical, and trustworthy.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Familiarity with communications and privacy laws
  • Large firm or in-house experience
  • AV peer review rating
  • Licensed in NY, Wash DC, or CA

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

All MCI Locations

  • Must be authorized to work in the country where the job is based.

Subject to the program and location of the position

  • Must be willing to submit up to a LEVEL II background and/or security investigation with a fingerprint. Job offers are contingent on background/security investigation results.
  • Must be willing to submit to drug screening. Job offers are contingent on drug screening results. (Does not apply in Canada)

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is the policy of MCI and its affiliates to provide reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability unless such accommodations would cause undue hardship. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment. If reasonable accommodations are needed, please contact Human Resources.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity is a benefit to our employees, our company, our customers, and our community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, it is the policy of MCI to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

ABOUT MCI (PARENT COMPANY)

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI’s subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines.

Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

Job Summary

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is the executive responsible for protecting the organization's information, technology infrastructure, applications, data, and digital services from cyber threats and security risks.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CISO leads enterprise cybersecurity, information security governance, cyber risk management, security architecture, incident response, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, third-party security, and business continuity/cyber resilience.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise cybersecurity and information security strategy.

Establish information security policies, standards, controls, and governance frameworks.

Lead enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk management.

Protect sensitive customer, financial, investment, policyholder, employee, and corporate data.

Oversee:

Security Operations (SOC)

Threat Detection & Response

Incident Response

Security Architecture

Vulnerability Management

Penetration Testing

Identity & Access Management

Endpoint Security

Network Security

Cloud Security

Data Security

Establish and manage cyber incident response and crisis-management processes.

Manage security audits, risk assessments, control testing, and remediation programs.

Develop and test Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Cyber Resilience plans.

Establish cybersecurity KPIs, KRIs, dashboards, and executive reporting.

Manage cybersecurity budgets, vendors, managed security providers, and strategic technology partners.

Lead and develop information-security and cybersecurity teams.

Advise the CEO, Board, Risk Committee, Audit Committee, and senior leadership on cyber risk.

Ensure cybersecurity risks are integrated into the organization's overall enterprise risk-management framework.

Did we mention this was a remote, work from home position?

Compensation & Benefits

At Carenet Health, we value the expertise and dedication of our team members, and we are committed to offering an appealing compensation package. The wage for the Customer Service Rep role is $16.00 per hour.

In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off (PTO) and holidays, flexible spending accounts (FSAs), employee wellness programs, and career development opportunities.

What you will do:

The Health Advisor serves as a key point of contact within Hoag’s Centralized Patient Service Center, supporting patients with scheduling and coordination across multiple service lines, including CT, MRI, mammography and bone density (DEXA), X-ray and ultrasound, laboratory, nuclear medicine, pulmonary, vascular, surgery and labor & delivery, as well as physician scheduling and general radiology call support.

In this role, the Health Advisor delivers a compassionate, efficient, and accurate patient experience while managing high-volume inbound interactions in a remote contact center environment. Responsibilities include scheduling, rescheduling, confirming appointments, addressing patient inquiries, and documenting all interactions in accordance with client protocols, HIPAA standards, and service expectations.

  • Manage inbound and outbound patient interactions to support scheduling and coordination of diagnostic imaging services.
  • Schedule, reschedule, cancel, and confirm patient appointments across diagnostic imaging and specialty service lines, including but not limited to CT, MRI, mammography/bone density (DEXA), X-ray/ultrasound, laboratory, nuclear medicine, pulmonary, vascular, surgery and labor & delivery, radiology and nuclear medicine physician scheduling, and main call support.

  • Accurately document all patient interactions, appointment details, and updates in the appropriate systems and CRM platforms.
  • Review patient orders, referrals, and provider instructions to ensure appointments are scheduled according to established guidelines and protocols.
  • Navigate multiple systems simultaneously (e.g., scheduling platforms, CRM tools, and communication systems) while maintaining accuracy and efficiency.
  • Communicate professionally with patients, providers, and internal teams to coordinate care and resolve scheduling needs.
  • Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and active listening skills while supporting patients throughout the scheduling process.
  • Follow established workflows, call flows, and knowledge resources when handling patient interactions and service requests.
  • Identify patient needs and take appropriate actions to ensure concerns are resolved, and service expectations are met.
  • Maintain productivity and quality standards in a fast-paced, high-volume contact center environment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to HIPAA regulations and all privacy and security standards.
  • Participate in required training programs, including modality-based training for imaging services.
  • Engage in coaching sessions and apply feedback to improve performance and service delivery.
  • Maintain consistent attendance and schedule adherence to support operational goals.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of six months of experience in a healthcare contact center, patient access, or customer service environment preferred, with hands-on experience scheduling medical appointments within a healthcare organization—preferably supporting diagnostic imaging, specialty care, or multi-department scheduling is required.
  • Required Work From Home experience in a private, secure, and distraction-free environment while maintaining full compliance with HIPAA and company data privacy standards.
  • Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and excellent telephone etiquette.
  • Demonstrated understanding of and consistent adherence to contact center performance metrics (e.g., adherence, quality, and service levels), in alignment with scorecard standards and Remote Work Agreement (RWA) expectations.
  • Ability to adhere to assigned schedules within program operating hours, demonstrating reliability, punctuality, and consistent attendance. Must be flexible to adjust shifts, swap coverage, and support overtime based on business needs, while maintaining timely and professional communication regarding schedule changes or absences.
  • Ability to manage multiple systems and tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established protocols and workflows.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to research and resolve customer inquiries effectively.
  • Basic computer proficiency including experience with Windows-based systems and applications such as Outlook, Teams, and CRM or scheduling platforms.

Flexibility to work assigned schedules, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as required

The Cruise Director is the leader of the Entertainment Department, managing diverse team members, impacting guest satisfaction using personality, talent, and language ability to communicate and entertain, from small to large social events and on the main stage.

Working with the Hotel Director and the onboard division heads, the Cruise Director is responsible for creating, developing, implementing, and supervising all guest activities and entertainment onboard the ship.   • Respect for all co-workers and guests.
  • Pride in your work by creating positive energy, excitement and fun.

Associate Principals contribute to the operational and fiscal health of the overall practice and training/success of junior staff.

Excellent knowledge of systematic literature review (SLR) methods and indirect treatment comparison (ITC). Significant experience leading and conducting ITC projects, including network meta-analysis, matching adjusted meta-analysis, etc. Expert understanding of global SLR guidelines and best practices, and substantial experience in implementing them.

  • Lead project teams to ensure the execution of rigorous and high quality deliverables according to timelines

  • Project management—manage projects, oversee the operational, financial, and administrative requirements of projects

Experience

This is a remote position.

Job Title: IT Project Manager (PMP), Rural Health Transformation Program
Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time (client working days only; no client holidays)
Location: Remote, United States (Eastern Time schedule)
Employment Type: W-2, full time, 40 hours per week
Pay Rate: $70/hr (W-2)
Engagement Type: Contract, anticipated start December 2026; duration tied to the implementation of the program's IT solutions (end date to be confirmed by the client)
Final Interview: Client interview by phone or video

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring an IT Project Manager on behalf of the client, a state government health and human services agency. The agency is responding to the federal Rural Health Transformation Program, a five-year funding initiative to make care more accessible, higher quality and better tailored to rural communities, and anticipates a series of IT focused missions in support of it. The Project Manager works within the state's Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO), follows its hybrid project lifecycle (Agile practices during implementation), takes direction from the EPMO Portfolio Manager, and manages one or more program projects day to day alongside the state project team, program sponsors, governance committees and implementation vendors. Preference is given to candidates who have managed similar health program or federally funded initiatives and who already work the way a state EPMO expects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain the project schedule in the EPMO-prescribed tool (activities, dependencies, milestones, start and end dates, resources, percent complete), updated weekly through closeout, and take part in weekly updates to the implementation vendor's master schedule.
  • Deliver weekly project status reports in the state's project management tool.
  • Create and maintain risks and issues in the state's tool, recommend responses, and run monthly risk and issue reviews.
  • Facilitate project meetings, including status, risk and issue review, backlog grooming, release planning and change review; publish agendas 24 hours before and minutes 24 hours after, distributed from the state document repository.
  • Track project financials and enter actual expenditures in the EPMO tool monthly or as approved changes affect the budget.
  • Manage change control with the EPMO Portfolio Manager and state governance committees, using the state's Change Request Form, and track changes in the project tool.
  • Track all deliverables in a deliverable approval matrix and manage the implementation vendor's Deliverable Expectation Documents (DED) and Deliverable Acceptance Forms (DAF).
  • Maintain the stakeholder register, decision log and action item log; engage program and project sponsors and governance committees on policy decisions, scope, resources, budget and escalated issues.
  • Facilitate project activities, including the state's procurement process.
  • Produce the deliverables required by state, agency and federal governance (for example CMS and FNS), following EPMO templates.
  • Organize and archive project artifacts in the state document repository.
  • Run lessons learned and produce the project closeout report at the end of each project.

Requirements

Requirements

Required:

  • Current PMP certification (copy of the certificate is required with the application).
  • Current HIPAA training certificate, or willingness to complete HIPAA training provided by Dhaka Technologies Limited Company before submission and maintain it for the duration of the engagement.
  • Experience managing IT implementation projects for state government, preferably for a health and human services, Medicaid or public health agency.
  • Experience managing an implementation vendor's schedule and deliverables, including deliverable review and acceptance.
  • Experience with hybrid or Agile delivery, including backlog grooming and release planning.
  • Three professional references, submitted with the application, from engagements within the last five years who can speak specifically to the candidate's project management work. Applications without three references will not be considered.
  • Proficiency with Azure DevOps and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Project, Visio) and Adobe PDF.
  • Strong organization, document repository management, and written and verbal communication.
  • Available full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099).
  • Must pass a national criminal background check, sign the client's acceptable use and confidentiality terms, work only on client-provided systems, and not use AI meeting assistants in client meetings.

Preferred:

  • Experience with federally funded health programs or grant initiatives (for example CMS, HRSA or rural health programs) and their reporting requirements.
  • Experience working within a state Enterprise Project Management Office and its templates and governance.
  • Experience managing several concurrent projects or a program of related projects.

How to Apply

Please send your resume, a copy of your PMP certificate (and HIPAA training certificate if you have one), and three professional references to with "IT Project Manager, Rural Health Transformation" in the subject line. For each reference, include the name, title, organization, email address, phone number, and the project management work the reference can speak to. References must be from engagements within the last five years. Applications submitted without three references will not be considered.

raw.description:
Role Overview

The Producer Services Readiness Lead serves as the senior Producer Services subject matter expert for translating approved requirements into practical workflows, standard operating procedures, training, service processes, controls, and launch plans. The role leads and coordinates readiness activities for new and changing business-process requirements within Producer Services.

The Lead applies sound operational judgment and escalates decisions involving policy, risk, resources, or cross-functional ownership to the appropriate Producer Services leader. The Lead coordinates readiness activities and assesses whether staff, workflows, materials, system dependencies, and escalation paths have been prepared before new producer-facing requirements go live, escalating unresolved readiness risks as appropriate.

The role provides targeted onboarding and Support readiness during launches and peak periods but does not become the standing owner of routine onboarding, Support production, regulatory interpretation, or technical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Readiness & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the Producer Services subject matter expert for the implementation of new and changing business-process requirements.
  • Translate approved policy, program, regulatory, financial, and operational decisions into clear Producer Services workflows and operating requirements.
  • Develop and recommend how approved requirements should be executed across affected Producer Services teams, working with team leaders to confirm the final operating approach.
  • Map current- and future-state processes, including roles, handoffs, decision rights, controls, exceptions, and escalation paths.
  • Identify missing decisions, process gaps, conflicting requirements, and dependencies that could prevent successful implementation.
  • Recommend practical operating approaches that balance producer clarity, control requirements, service quality, and available capacity for review and approval by Producer Services leadership.
  • Maintain awareness of new and changing Producer Services processes across registration, reporting, validation, adjustments, corrections, payments, delinquency, and regulator referrals to support readiness planning and implementation activities.
  • Process Implementation & Operationalization
  • Assess the operational feasibility and impacts of new or changing requirements affecting Producer Services.

About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

Head of Growth — LumiMeds
Location: Remote | Type: Full-time | Reports to: Founder/CEO
About LumiMeds
LumiMeds is a fast-growing telehealth company making GLP-1 weight-loss treatment (semaglutide & tirzepatide) accessible, affordable, and effective. We've built a real business with real patients and real outcomes — and we're just getting started. We move fast, test relentlessly, and let data settle arguments.
The Role
We're hiring a Head of Growth to own our growth engine end-to-end — online and offline. This is not a channel-manager seat. You'll set the growth strategy, run experiments across every lever (paid, organic, referral, partnerships, experiential, OOH, guerrilla), and personally drive the initiatives that move the business. You bring a playbook of proven tactics, the scrappiness to execute them on a lean budget, and the analytical rigor to know what's actually working.

If you've grown a consumer business from scratch, thrive in ambiguity, and get a thrill out of finding the unlock nobody else saw — this is your seat.
What You'll Do
  • Own the full growth strategy across digital and offline channels — you set the roadmap and the number you're accountable to.
  • Run growth end-to-end: ideation → hypothesis → execution → measurement → iterate. You don't hand things off; you drive them to the finish.
  • Build and scale offline growth initiatives — experiential, OOH, guerrilla, events, partnerships, retail, and channels we haven't thought of yet.
  • Scale digital acquisition — paid social/search, lifecycle, referral, affiliate, SEO/content — and squeeze efficiency out of every dollar.
  • Bring proven playbooks — you've done this before and can point to specific tactics that worked, and why.
  • Research relentlessly — find new channels, size opportunities, study competitors, and pressure-test ideas before we spend.
  • Negotiate with vendors and partners — you get more for less and structure deals that de-risk our spend.
  • Live in the data — instrument everything, measure CAC/LTV/payback obsessively, and kill what doesn't work fast.
What You Bring
  • Track record of growing a business — you can show real numbers you were directly responsible for moving.
  • Both offline and digital growth experience — you're equally comfortable running a guerrilla campaign and a paid-acquisition dashboard.
  • A documented playbook of growth tactics you've run and can run again.
  • True growth-hacker DNA — scrappy, resourceful, and biased toward action on a lean budget.
  • Data-driven decision-making — you form hypotheses, run clean tests, and follow the numbers.
  • End-to-end ownership — you take an idea from napkin to launched, measured, and scaled.
  • Strong research and negotiation skills — you find the opportunity and close the deal.
  • Bonus: DTC, subscription, telehealth, wellness, or regulated-vertical experience.
Why LumiMeds
  • Direct access to the founder and a mandate to move fast.
  • A real product with proven demand and outcomes — you're pouring fuel on a fire, not starting one.
  • Full ownership of growth, with the budget and autonomy to prove your playbook.

How to Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps.

LumiMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and alignment with our values.

Please note: This role requires professional-level English communication and availability to work U.S. business hours.
