raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

As a Solutions Engineer for Turkey / EMEA, you will be the go-to product and technical expert for Alpaca's enterprise partners across and the wider Turkey / EMEA region. You will bridge technical and business conversations: a customer-facing engineer with strong API knowledge, experience supporting enterprise customers, fluency in Turkish for customer interactions, and sufficient English proficiency to collaborate effectively with our global team. You will support enterprise partners and expand our base of enterprise partners in Turkey / EMEA, acting as the technical bridge between local partners, vendors, and regulators and Alpaca's global engineering team.

What you will do:

  • Provide technical support and relationship management for existing enterprise customers in Turkey / EMEA , acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the partner lifecycle.
  • Partner with the Sales and Solutions teams on pre-sales technical discussions, solution design, and API consultations, and present compelling product and technical use cases to prospective clients.
  • Guide new enterprise customers through API integration, implementation, and onboarding.
  • Act as the voice of Turkish customers by collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve localized experiences; translate complex business and technical requirements (often originating in Turkish) into clear specifications for Alpaca's global engineering team.
  • Serve as the product and technical subject matter expert, capable of thoroughly understanding and articulating all aspects of the Alpaca platform to diverse audiences and stakeholders.
  • Work closely with local compliance and operations teams to understand local and regional product requirements.
  • Own technical Solutions engagement end-to-end: discovery calls, solution validation, RFPs, and security questionnaires that win deals; lead demo strategy and execution.
  • Create Solutions support materials and documentation for new features and products, including Turkish-language collateral where needed.
  • Coordinate in Turkish with local regulators, vendors, and partners, and relay those requirements to global product and engineering.
  • Help customers successfully adopt Alpaca's platform while maintaining a high standard of technical and customer support; travel within Turkey / EMEA as needed.
  • Stay updated on internal product development timelines and work closely with the product team to test and roll out new features to partners.

What we look for (Must-Haves):

  • Experience supporting enterprise / B2B customers in a technical, sales engineering, or solutions engineering role (typically 3+ years), ideally at API or SaaS-first companies.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, SDKs, and software integration workflows; hands-on experience with APIs, WebSockets, Postman, Grafana, and JSON.
  • Native or business-level Turkish, with excellent customer communication skills and a solid understanding of Turkish business culture - essential for partner, vendor, and regulator communication.
  • Business-level English for collaborating with global, cross-functional teams; able to drive clarity on goals, set expectations, and collect feedback effectively.
  • Able to translate complex technical concepts into simple, understandable terms.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a startup environment, manages multiple assignments simultaneously, works independently, and drives projects to completion with close attention to detail.

Who You Might Be (Nice-To-Haves):

  • Experience in fintech, capital markets, brokerage, or financial APIs; experience at a Broker-Dealer or securities firm in Turkey / EMEA.
  • Knowledge of brokerage, post-trade, and settlement operations, as well as regulatory context.
  • Closing enterprise deals alongside Account Executives.
  • US securities qualifications (e.g., SIE and/or Series 7).
  • Familiarity with Metabase.
  • Experience working with the FIX protocol.
  • Experience working with OpenAPI, ReadMe, and documentation.
  • Excited to learn more about the securities industry.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

raw.excerpt: As the global leader in AI-powered customer experience assurance, we help some of the world's most recognized brands deliver seamless, reliable, and engaging interactions across voice, digital, messaging, and AI-powered channels.
raw.description:
As the global leader in AI-powered customer experience assurance, we help some of the world's most recognized brands deliver seamless, reliable, and engaging interactions across voice, digital, messaging, and AI-powered channels. Every year, our platform helps optimize hundreds of millions of customer journeys, ensuring businesses can confidently deliver exceptional experiences at scale.
As enterprises race to deploy agentic AI, the defining question is no longer whether AI can handle customer interactions, it’s whether those interactions can be trusted. Cyara is the confidence layer that answers that question, testing AI agents with AI agents to detect hallucinations, validate decisions, and ensure compliance before failures ever reach your customers.
Joining Cyara means helping shape the future of customer experience, partnering with some of the world’s biggest brands, and working alongside passionate, talented people who are committed to making every customer interaction better.

The Role

    The Managed Services Consultant is a hands-on post-enablement consultant responsible for helping Cyara customers operate, adopt, and gain ongoing value from the platform after implementation. Reporting to the Principal Professional Services Consultant, this role supports assigned customer accounts through recurring managed services activities, platform guidance, workflow execution, operational follow-through, documentation, and coordination with internal teams to address issues that impact adoption, reliability, or customer outcomes.

What You'll Do

    Post-Enablement Customer Support & Workflow Execution (30–35%)
  • Support assigned Cyara customer accounts after enablement by helping users navigate the platform, complete recurring workflows, and maintain operational momentum.
  • Execute managed services activities such as platform assistance, configuration support, monitoring coordination, reporting, operational requests, and customer follow-through.
  • Track assigned actions, requests, risks, and dependencies to ensure timely completion and clear communication with customers and internal stakeholders.
    • Platform Guidance, Adoption & Operational Quality (25–30%)
  • Provide practical platform guidance that helps customers use Cyara consistently, mature adoption, and improve day-to-day operational confidence.
  • Assist with configuration updates, maintenance activities, integrations, release readiness, and safe delivery of customer-impacting platform changes.
  • Document customer workflows, known issues, best practices, and handoffs to improve repeatability, continuity, and service quality.
    • Issue Management, SLAs & Cross-Functional Coordination (20–25%)
  • Monitor assigned requests, backlog items, SLA commitments, customer health signals, and issue progress across managed services work.
  • Coordinate with Support, Engineering, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services to resolve platform issues, dependencies, and customer-impacting risks.
  • Escalate risks or blockers appropriately and provide clear status updates until issues are resolved or transitioned to the right owner.
    • Process Improvement & Managed Services Enablement (15–20%)
  • Identify gaps in managed services delivery processes, customer workflows, documentation, handoffs, and support agreements.
  • Recommend improvements that increase operational efficiency, service consistency, SLA performance, and customer satisfaction.
  • Contribute to reusable playbooks, templates, knowledge articles, and reporting practices that help the Managed Services function scale

What We're Looking For

    Managed Services, Customer Operations & Consulting Skills
  • Relevant experience in managed services, customer operations, professional services, technical services, SaaS delivery, or medium-to-large IT operations environments.
  • Ability to manage assigned customer activities, requests, dependencies, documentation, follow-through, and stakeholder communication with limited oversight.
  • Strong customer engagement, service orientation, collaboration, problem-solving, and professional communication skills.
  • Comfort working across technical and business stakeholders to clarify needs, coordinate actions, and support customer outcomes.

    • Technical, IT Operations & Platform Skills

  • Some understanding of IT operations, Agentic (LLM, NLP), SaaS applications, managed service offerings, customer support models, and post-enablement adoption workflows.
  • Ability to support platform configuration, maintenance, integrations, release readiness, issue diagnosis, reporting, and reliable customer adoption.
  • Some understanding of project management principles and ability to organize work, track actions, manage priorities, and follow through across teams.
    • Academic Qualifications, Certifications & Required Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in information technology, business, operations, or a related field.
  • ITIL v4 knowledge or certification preferred; relevant technical, SaaS platform, or customer success certifications a plus.
  • Demonstrable experience supporting customer accounts, technical operations, managed services activities, or post-implementation SaaS adoption.

Why This Role

  • You’ll help Cyara customers succeed after enablement by supporting daily platform usage, adoption, and operational continuity.
  • You’ll work closely with the Principal Professional Services Consultant and cross-functional teams to resolve customer needs and improve managed services delivery.
  • You’ll contribute to the growth of Cyara’s Managed Services practice through repeatable workflows, documentation, and customer-focused execution.

Why you should join us: 

Looking for a place where your ideas matter, your growth is accelerated, and your work creates real impact? Welcome to Cyara.
We're building the assurance layer that gives enterprises the confidence to deploy agentic AI at scale with a global team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Whether you're launching new ideas, solving complex problems, or learning from talented colleagues across the world, you'll be surrounded by people who challenge and support you to do your best work.
At Cyara, inclusivity isn't a buzzword, it's part of who we are. We foster a culture where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to contribute. Pair that with competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, flexible work options, recognition programs, and a strong focus on employee well-being, and you've got a workplace designed for both success and fulfilment.
Big opportunities. Real impact. Amazing people. That's the Cyara experience.
Cyara’s Diversity, Equity, Inclusive and Belonging Statement: 
At Cyara, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace that embodies equal opportunity and champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). We strive to cultivate an environment where every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, contributing unique perspectives and talents. Our commitment includes continuously evaluating and enhancing our policies, practices, and culture to align with our DEIB principles. We ensure a discrimination-free environment where individuals are evaluated solely on their merits and abilities, regardless of legally protected statuses such as sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or medical condition. By celebrating our differences and championing inclusivity, we enrich our organization, make more thoughtful decisions, and drive collective success. 
Cyara’s Values Statement: At Cyara, our values shape everything we do. We're passionate about Delivering Excellence by putting the customer first, collaborating globally, and always striving to improve.We take smart risks and Innovate Boldly, setting new standards and learning from every experience. Integrity First is our cornerstone, we value humility, authenticity, and respect for diversity, building trust in all we do. We Embrace Curiosity by empowering you to experiment, learn, and grow in a dynamic environment. At Cyara, our values drive us forward, shaping a culture where innovation and excellence thrive. 
Agencies: Thanks, but we’ve got this one! Please, no phone calls or emails to any employees of Cyara outside of the Talent Acquisition team. Cyara’s policy is to only accept resumes from Agencies via the Cyara Agency Portal. Agencies must have a valid fee agreement in place, and they must have been assigned the specific requisition to which they submit resumes, by the Cyara Talent Acquisition team before submitting any CVs. Any resume submitted outside of this process will be deemed the sole property of Cyara and, in the event, a candidate is submitted outside of this policy is hired, no fee or payment of any kind will be paid.

We are seeking an analytical, strategic, and proactive Provisioning Specialist. In this role, you will serve as a key operational strategist and system administrator within our customer onboarding and delivery pipeline. You will exercise independent judgment to design, evaluate, and execute software environment setups, oversee financial processing integrations, and direct client regulatory compliance frameworks.

The ideal candidate evaluates complex operational requirements, establishes scalable workflows, exercises discretion on technical provisioning edge-cases, and collaborates cross-functionally to drive continuous process improvements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Systems Architecture & Provisioning Strategy: Evaluate client technical requirements to determine, configure, and execute appropriate WorkWave database environments. Analyze implementation data to continuously optimize configuration methodologies for platform onboarding.
  • Financial Activation: Direct the strategy and execution for activating WorkWave Payments functionality across customer accounts, evaluating risk, technical readiness, and financial compliance prior to activation.
  • Compliance Management: Formulate and manage client registration strategies for A2P 10DLC text messaging compliance. Serve as the subject matter expert on evolving industry regulations to ensure customer and platform alignment.
  • Operational Governance: Establish, maintain, and enforce team governance policy regarding service scope and resource allocation. Analyze incoming service requests, evaluate business impacts, and exercise independent authority to approve, reject, or re-route non-standard requests.

raw.description:
FILINVEST LAND, INC.

The Web Development and CRM Manager orchestrates Filinvest's enterprise-wide lifecycle marketing, marketing automation, customer data management, and personalization strategy. This role ensures that CRM becomes a powerful engine for lead nurturing, lead-to-reservation conversion, customer onboarding, experience delivery, retention and reactivation, cross-sell and upsell, and lifetime value maximization

The CRM Manager leads the design and execution of automated customer journeys, governs segmentation logic, maintains data integrity in partnership with Tech Platform and Customer Insights, and ensures a consistent, empathetic, and brand-aligned communication experience across the lifecycle.

This role serves as a critical bridge between Digital, Brand & CX, Customer Insights, Operations, and Residential BUs — ensuring that CRM activities support business outcomes and reinforce a unified customer experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. CRM Strategy & Lifecycle Journey Orchestration

  • Orchestrate Filinvest's CRM strategy across the entire customer lifecycle:

Lead Inquiry Reservation Documentation Loan Processing Construction Turnover After-sales Renewal/Renegotiation

  • Lead the development of automated journeys for lead nurturing, buyer onboarding, requirements completion, construction updates, turnover readiness, move-in support, after-sales support, delinquency reminders (in coordination with Operations), and ensure all journeys are customer-centric, brand-aligned, and optimized for conversion.

2. Audience Segmentation & Personalization

  • Govern enterprise-level segmentation in partnership with Customer Insights.
  • Build and maintain audience segments based on behavior, engagement level, funnel stage, persona, project category
  • Ensure personalization across email, SMS, in-app or portal messaging, construction updates, buyer education content
  • Maintain dynamic segments and eligibility rules for all automated journeys.

3. CRM Automation Design & Optimization

  • Build automation flows such as welcome series, lead nurturing sequences, document submission reminders, construction phase triggers, turnover scheduling, move-in prompts, maintenance reminders
  • Continuously optimize timing, frequency, message relevance, conversion triggers, content clarity
  • Implement A/B testing for subject lines, content, CTA, and cadence.

4. Data Integrity, Tagging & Lead Management

  • Govern the cleanliness and structure of CRM data.
  • Ensure correct lead tagging and routing in alignment with sales, BUs, digital, tech platform
  • Implement data hygiene routines for re-duplication, bounce management, unsubscribe management, record validation
  • Maintain data dictionaries, segment logic documentation, and data governance standards.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the following business functions:

1) Digital & Performance Teams to ensure CRM journeys support paid campaigns, provide audience insights to improve targeting, and align UTM, tracking, and attribution flows.

2) Brand & CX Team to ensure CRM content is on-brand, clear and human, empathetic, segment-appropriate, CX-compliant

3) Customer Insights to validate segments, insights, and behavioral clustering and use NPS, CSAT, and qualitative insights to enhance CRM journeys.

4) Residential Business Units to ensure BU-level needs (project launches, updates, inventories) are supported via CRM.

5) Operations & Customer Care to maintain alignment for customer-facing notifications and service updates.

6. Reporting, Analytics & Optimization

  • Track CRM KPIs: open rates, CTR, response rates, lead-to-reservation conversion, journey drop-off points, and engagement scores
  • Maintain CRM dashboards with Customer Insights and Tech Platform.
  • Produce monthly insights and recommendations for journey improvement across BUs.
  • Present findings to the CMO and the Digital COE.

7. Governance, Standards & Compliance

  • Establish enterprise CRM content standards: tone of voice, template formatting, brand/CX alignment, response scripts, opt-outs and compliance
  • Maintain CRM playbooks and implementation guidelines.
  • Ensure compliance with: data privacy laws (DPA), opt-in/opt-out rules, Corporate Communications protocols

8. Team Leadership & Vendor Management

  • Lead CRM Specialists and support roles.
  • Coach team in automation building, journey design, data hygiene, segment creation, amd reporting and optimization
  • Oversee CRM platform vendors and Martech providers.
  • Manage configurations, integrations, and enhancements with Tech Platform.

ROLE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, IT, Communications, Data Science, or related field.
  • 5–8 years of CRM experience in:

1) Lifecycle marketing

2) Marketing automation

3) Segmentation

4) Behavior-driven communications

5) Customer journey management

  • Experience with CRM platforms (MoEngage, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of funnel conversion, segmentation, and lead nurturing principles.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally at enterprise scale.

  • posiadasz wiedzę na temat migracji rozwiązań on-premise do GCP i znasz różne typy migracji (lift-and-shift, re-platform, re-architect),
  • wiesz, jak stosować mechanizmy bezpiecznego przechowywania i przetwarzania danych w GCP (VPC Service Controls, CMEK, DLP, Cloud KMS),
  • brałeś(aś) udział w spotkaniach przedsprzedażowych i umiesz przekładać wymagania biznesowe na rozwiązania techniczne,

raw.title: CRM Strategist (LATAM)
raw.excerpt: Who Are Massive Rocket? Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect.
raw.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.
Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As a CRM Strategist at Massive Rocket, you’ll work hand‑in‑hand with our Principal CRM Strategist to shape and deliver CRM strategies that move the needle for our clients. You’ll help build strategic plans, translate them into clear, actionable initiatives, and ensure they’re handed over smoothly to the execution team so they can drive KPIs, performance, and measurable ROI.
You’ll play a key role in turning complex frameworks into simple, compelling narratives — the kind that teams can execute confidently and clients can rally behind. You’ll join client sessions throughout the Delivery Sales Lifecycle, helping uncover core challenges and contributing to data‑driven marketing strategies that make a real impact.
You’ll also support the creation of pitches that tell powerful stories through strategy, data, and insight. And you’ll run strategy sessions grounded in lifecycle thinking, best practices, and proven principles to help clients unlock long‑term success.

What Will You Do?

  • Turn complex frameworks into simple, compelling narratives that teams can execute confidently
  • Join client sessions throughout the Delivery Sales Lifecycle to uncover challenges and shape data‑driven strategies
  • Support the creation of pitches that tell powerful stories through strategy, data, and insight
  • Run strategy sessions grounded in lifecycle thinking, best practices, and proven CRM principles
  • Translate strategic recommendations into clear, actionable plans for execution teams
  • Contribute to measurable client success by aligning strategy with KPIs and ROI goals

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 6+ years of hands‑on CRM experience, including at least 2 years in a dedicated CRM Strategy role within an agency, consultancy, or client‑side team
  • Strong working knowledge of leading CRM platforms such as Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or HubSpot
  • Confident presenting complex strategies and turning insights into clear value propositions and achievable activation plans
  • Data‑driven mindset, with experience analysing customer communications and using insights to shape future campaigns — from audience selection to next‑best actions, content, and timing
  • Deep understanding of CRM ecosystems and Martech, with expertise across platforms like Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, and similar tools

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
  • A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
  • A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
  • Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
  • Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
  • Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)
References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready
For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

raw.excerpt: About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are.
raw.description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

If you’re passionate about solving technical issues and providing high-quality support to a diverse community of users, this is the role for you. We’re seeking a motivated Support Engineer (Tier 1) to join our growing team of support professionals. You will serve as the face of the company for a large portion of our community, handling a broad range of tickets that will help flex your technical muscles.

As a Tier 1 engineer, you’ll be part of a distributed team focused on delivering excellent support and proactively solving friction by partnering with our broader CX team and Product/Eng. This role reports directly to the Tier 1 Support Team Lead and will play a key role in our journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical resource for less complex issues, resolving a wide range of configuration and networking challenges to keep them unblocked.
  • Manage a high-velocity ticket queue with a consistent focus on meeting targets for time to first response and time to resolution.
  • Drive positive user outcomes and maintain high CSAT scores by providing clear, helpful, and accurate technical guidance.
  • Balance a high volume of daily ticket replies while maintaining the technical depth required to troubleshoot complex networking issues.
  • Partner cross-functionally to identify recurring friction points and advocate for improvements to the user experience.

What We Are Looking For

  • Display a natural tinkerer’s mindset and a deep curiosity for how things work, likely demonstrated through personal projects, homelabs, or open-source contributions.
  • Demonstrate a foundational understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, IP addressing, firewalls, and routing.
  • Show proficiency in troubleshooting across multiple operating systems such as macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile OS’s.
  • Some familiarity with Jira and Slack to manage internal workflows and communicate effectively with the team and customers
  • Exhibit excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts with empathy and clarity.
  • Maintain a proactive approach to learning new technologies and staying current with evolving infra tools.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range
£49,770—£78,210 GBP

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit .

raw.excerpt: Start: ab sofort | Level: Lead | Location: Deutschland, remote| Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche) Als Master Data Management Lead trägst du die strategische Gesamtverantwortung für das Stammdatenmanagement im gesamten Unternehmen.
raw.description:
Start: ab sofort | Level: Lead | Location: Deutschland, remote| Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit (40h/Woche)

Als Master Data Management Lead trägst du die strategische Gesamtverantwortung für das Stammdatenmanagement im gesamten Unternehmen. Die Rolle definiert die Governance-Struktur, setzt Prioritäten für MDM-Initiativen und stellt sicher, dass Datenverantwortung, Entscheidungsrechte und Prozesse klar festgelegt sind. Die Rolle fungiert als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen der Geschäftsstrategie und den operativen Daten.

Die Rolle ist remote in Deutschland zu besetzen mit gelegentlichen Besuchen im Headquarter in Hamburg (im ersten Jahr etwa 1x im Monat, danach seltener möglich).

Deine Mission bei uns

  • Du verantwortest die globale MDM-Strategie, die Roadmap sowie das Data-Governance-Framework und definierst klare Datenverantwortlichkeiten (Data Ownership)
  • Du baust ein zentrales MDM Center of Competence (CoC) innerhalb der TQG Gruppe auf, etablierst Standards und sicherst den internen Know-how-Aufbau
  • Du führst das MDM-Team fachlich/disziplinarisch und koordinierst die Business- sowie Technical-Data-Stewards
  • Du gestaltest das Master Data Operating Model (MDOM) sowie durchgängige, domänenübergreifende Stammdatenprozesse (Produkt, Kunde, Lieferant, Finanzen, Logistik)
  • Du agierst als Brücke zu den Geschäftsbereichen (SCM, Vertrieb, Finanzen etc.) und leitest strategische Governance-Gremien
  • Du definierst und überwachst MDM-Kennzahlen (KPIs) mittels Dashboards und treibst kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse voran
  • Du arbeitest eng mit der MDM-Datenarchitektur zusammen, um strategische Vorgaben optimal in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen
  • Du förderst aktiv den Kulturwandel hin zu gelebter Datenverantwortung im gesamten Unternehmen

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

  • Du bringst mindestens 7 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich MDM, Data Governance oder in datengetriebenen Transformationsprojekten mit
  • Du hast idealerweise ein fundiertes Branchen-Know-how in den Bereichen FMCG, Lebensmittel, Nahrungsergänzungsmittel oder Handel
  • Du besitzt nachweisbare Führungskompetenz in abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten sowie Erfahrung im Aufbau von MDM-Governance-Strukturen in mittelständischen Unternehmen
  • Du verstehst End-to-End-Stammdatenprozesse (insbesondere Produkt, Kunde, Lieferant und Finanzen) bis ins kleinste Detail
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP S/4HANA im Stammdatenkontext und bist vertraut mit Systemen wie ERP, PIM (z. B. Akeneo), CRM, WMS oder PLM (z. B. Centric)
  • Du hast praktisches Know-how in Bezug auf Datenmodelle, Systemintegrationen und die Logik von „Golden Records“
  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte, analytische und strategische Denkweise gepaart mit einer Dokumentationsqualität auf Top-Management-Niveau aus
  • Du überzeugst mit starken Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeiten, um den organisatorischen Wandel voranzutreiben, und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Workation-Optionen und mehr

raw.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a skilled Full-Stack Engineer to join our Experimentation team! You’ll collaborate closely with a cross-functional team of backend, frontend, and full-stack engineers, along with product managers, data scientists, and designers, to help build an experimentation platform that balances power and accessibility. In this role, you’ll contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable, performant services using Go and RESTful APIs, and user experiences built with React and TypeScript. You’ll have opportunities to take ownership of projects, grow your technical expertise, and help improve the quality and reliability of our systems. We’re focused on building a best-in-class experimentation platform that enables customers to run impactful, data-driven experiments with ease and confidence, and we’re actively growing the team to deliver on this vision.

We are committed to delivering a leading experimentation platform that empowers our customers to run tests and data-driven experiments seamlessly and at scale. We have a robust product roadmap, and we are actively expanding our teams to execute on it.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of scalable and performant solutions for experimentation and data-driven products, with attention to usability and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on architectural decisions that impact system scalability and performance.
  • Lead limited scope features from definition to deployment
  • Help identify and troubleshoot performance issues and participate in efforts to optimize service reliability.
  • Work closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to implement new features and iterate on existing functionality.
  • Participate in code reviews to support code quality and share constructive feedback with teammates.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that enhances the reusability and readability of team systems.
  • Contribute to the team’s efforts to improve observability, monitoring, and operational excellence.
  • Help investigate and resolve production issues, occasionally partnering with customer support or other teams as needed.
  • Collaborate across functions to align on priorities, surface blockers, and improve team workflows.
  • Learn from and support more senior engineers, and contribute to a culture of growth, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Stay current with industry trends related to software development, experimentation, and backend technologies.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, creative thinking, and a proactive mindset in problem-solving.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building full stack web applications. Familiarity with Typescript, React, Node, and Go is preferred but not required.
  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, design patterns, and coding best practices.
  • Exposure to building or maintaining scalable, production-grade systems.
  • Familiarity with observability practices and tools (e.g., logging, metrics, monitoring).
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with a team-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in Agile development environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tools.
  • Passion for writing high-quality code and continuously improving engineering practices.
  • A self-motivated approach and willingness to take initiative.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Prior experience working with or contributing to distributed teams is a plus.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

Команда Київстар.Тех в пошуку нового колеги або коліжанки на роль Business/System Analyst.

Про нас

Kyivstar.Tech — українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв’язку.

Наша місія — змінювати життя в Україні та світі, створюючи технологічні рішення і продукти, що реалізують потенціал компаній і потреби користувачів.

Понад 600 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та вебрішення, а також проєктування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.

Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен із нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове.

Що ти будеш робити

  • Брати участь в розробці архітектурних рішень по впровадженню Маркетингових ініціатив (МА) і Продуктів у якості експерта/аналітика в білінговій системі
  • Надавати високорівневу оцінку складності змін для впровадження Продуктів
  • Аналізувати вимоги з замовниками, будувати та описувати схеми (class diagram, statechart diagram, sequence diagram, deployment diagram, component diagram та ін.) використовуючи формат запису BPMNv2, UML або інші підходи, пропонувати варіанти рішень та функціонал
  • Погоджувати зміни з замовниками та командою, котра відповідає за розробку Продуктів
  • Готувати технічну документацію (ТЗ) в Confluence. Відповідати за наповнення та підписання ТЗ що до технічної реалізації Продукту в системі BSS
  • Розробляти та деталізувати вимоги до функціоналу нового продукту для постачальника системи
  • Брати участь у внесенні змін до конфігурації системи
  • Оформлювати замовлення на доробки по системі Контролювати своєчасне і якісне впровадження вимог до функціоналу продукту відповідно до замовлень
  • Брати участь у процесі тестування впроваджених змін на системі та перевіряти їх відповідність вимогам замовника.
  • Аналізувати причини виникнення дефекту функціоналу Продукту
  • Деталізувати вимоги для виправлення дефекту або невідповідність реалізації бізнес вимогам
  • Погоджувати зміни з замовниками
  • Забезпечувати усунення дефектів підрядником

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

  • Не менше 2 років досвіду роботи в якості аналітика
  • Навички формування вимог до інформаційних систем відповідно потреб бізнесу, досвід впровадження в інформаційних системах нового функціоналу
  • Досвід ведення комунікації з підрядником
  • Впевнений користувач JIRA, Confluence
  • Знання офісних програм MsOffice. Бажано MS Project
  • Навички роботи з BPMN, UML

Ми пропонуємо

  • Офіс або ремоут — вирішувати тобі.
  • Ремоут онбординг
  • Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі)
  • Навчаємо працівників: є безліч внутрішніх ресурсів і програм від партнерів, власна бібліотека
  • Страхування здоров’я і життя для працівників
  • Wellbeing-програма та корпоративний психолог
  • Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв’язок Київстар

raw.description:
Role Overview

The Payroll Specialist partners directly with clients to support payroll processing and implementation using the platforms and systems we’ve helped implement. With strong Canadian payroll expertise, this role serves as a trusted resource to clients implementing and using ERP and HR/payroll solutions in Canada, helping them establish
accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll processes.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on Canadian payroll experience with HR/payroll systems implementation and strong communication, analytical, and client service skills. They understand Canadian federal and provincial requirements and can translate those requirements into system configuration, business processes, and practical client guidance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with clients to understand Canadian payroll and HR business processes, requirements, and objectives.
  • Support clients implementing and processing Canadian payroll within ERP and HR/payroll systems, providing guidance on system use, payroll regulations, and standard workflows.
  • Apply knowledge of Canadian payroll requirements and provincial nuances to help clients establish compliant payroll processes and system configurations.
  • Troubleshoot payroll and system issues, determine root causes, and escalate technical concerns as needed.
  • Provide proactive support during critical payroll cycles, including payroll deadlines, year-end reporting, and regulatory changes.
  • Conduct client trainings or refreshers on payroll tools, processes, Canadian payroll requirements, and system updates.
  • Collaborate internally with implementation teams to ensure smooth handoff from implementation to ongoing client support.
  • Stay current on Canadian payroll legislation, regulatory requirements, and technology platform enhancements to better serve client needs.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate client documentation, call notes, configurations, and case updates.

Minimum Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience working with Canadian payroll, with a strong understanding of Canadian payroll processes, requirements, and compliance.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Canadian federal and provincial payroll requirements and the ability to apply those requirements within payroll or ERP systems.
  • Experience working with payroll and/or HR systems in an implementation, consulting, systems, or client-facing capacity.
  • Experience supporting or implementing payroll for Canadian organizations; experience working across multiple provinces is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with payroll platforms such as Paymate, ADP Canada, or similar; experience with Canadian payroll systems such as Rippling, Payworks, and Dayforce is a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects or client implementations simultaneously while delivering high-quality results.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients through video, phone, email, and other remote collaboration tools.
  • Exceptional communication, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness and ability to learn new technology platforms and obtain Intacct and Sage HCM certifications.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience with Canadian payroll within an ERP implementation or consulting environment.
  • Familiarity with Canadian payroll complexities, including provincial requirements, statutory deductions, taxable benefits, vacation pay, year-end requirements, and other jurisdiction-specific considerations.
  • Payroll certification such as PCP, CPM, FPC, or CPP, or willingness to pursue relevant certification.
  • Familiarity with Construction Payroll, including Union and Prevailing Wage.
  • A natural collaborator and coach with a client-first mindset.
  • Adaptable and resourceful in dynamic or complex client environments.
  • Committed to continuous learning, regulatory awareness, and process improvement.

Always Choose Exceptional | Lead with Integrity | Embody Respect and Care Deeply | Embrace Change and Innovation

Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the US or Canada; we cannot provide sponsorship at this time.

Salary: 55,000-70,000 USD

We have raised more than $300 million from top-tier investors such as Bain Capital, Insight Partners, and Goldman Sachs. We have been named among the top 100 AI companies in the world.
Please note that while this role is listed as available for remote, we are currently employing in the following states: AK, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV. We have offices in Santa Clara, CA and Charlotte, NC for employees who prefer to work regularly or occasionally from an office.
You will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of customers while leading a team responsible for helping hospitals successfully adopt LeanTaaS solutions to achieve meaningful operational outcomes.
This is a hands-on leadership role where you will build and scale a growing Clinical Workflow Implementation team while remaining actively engaged in strategic customer implementations. As an early leader of this function, you'll work directly with customers to establish implementation best practices, refine delivery methodologies, and create scalable processes that improve efficiency and enable the team to deliver exceptional outcomes as it grows. Success in this role requires balancing customer delivery, people leadership, and operational excellence while serving as a trusted advisor to hospital executives and an experienced coach to your team. Over time, as the organization expands, you will transition more of your focus toward developing people, driving operational strategy, and scaling a high-performing implementation organization.
If you are passionate about improving healthcare delivery, developing high-performing teams, and helping hospitals optimize patient flow, we would love to have you on board!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

    Drive Implementation Success & Executive Engagement
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic customer implementations from discovery through go-live, including operational workflow analysis, solution design, project leadership, and change management planning.
  • Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, governance teams, and clinical leaders, serving as a strategic advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Drive executive engagement by facilitating governance meetings, executive business reviews, and strategic discussions that align implementation progress with customer goals and operational outcomes.
  • Provide executive oversight across the broader implementation portfolio by proactively identifying risks, developing mitigation strategies, and ensuring successful customer outcomes.
  • Serve as the primary point of escalation for customer, operational, and implementation challenges, partnering with customer executives and internal leadership to resolve complex issues and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Provide ongoing oversight of implementation standards, ensuring teams consistently execute established methodologies while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and greater scalability.
  • Communicate implementation progress, portfolio health, risks, and strategic recommendations to customer and internal executive stakeholders, ensuring transparency, alignment, and successful value realization.

    • Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and customer success.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, mentorship, and performance feedback while supporting career development and professional growth.
  • Partner with team members on implementation strategy, workflow optimization, executive presentations, and customer escalations to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Support Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers through complex customer engagements by providing coaching, strategic direction, and support during critical milestones and executive discussions.
  • Monitor team performance, implementation quality, customer satisfaction, and project health while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, and performance management to build and retain a high-performing implementation team.

    • Drive Operational Excellence

  • Establish and promote implementation best practices, standard methodologies, and repeatable playbooks across the team.
  • Design and continuously improve scalable implementation methodologies, tools, and operational playbooks that increase team efficiency, reduce resource requirements, and enable consistent delivery as the organization grows.
  • Leverage deep knowledge of inpatient hospital operations, patient throughput, bed management, admissions, transfers, and discharge workflows to guide both customers and team members.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve implementation processes and outcomes, contribute customer insights to product roadmap discussions, and support marketing initiatives such as case studies and user community engagement.
  • Use implementation metrics, customer feedback, and operational data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of related experience
  • A passion for customer success with a commitment to building lasting customer relationships and developing high-performing teams
  • Healthcare background in inpatient operations management, patient flow, capacity management, nursing leadership, or a related clinical specialty
  • 8+ years of experience working with hospitals or healthcare operations
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a client- or customer-facing role such as management consulting, implementation management, or customer success
  • 2+ years of people management experience, including coaching, mentoring, and managing customer-facing teams
  • Experience building, scaling, or transforming implementation, consulting, or customer-facing operations through process improvement and organizational growth
  • Demonstrated expertise in patient throughput, bed management, admissions, transfers, discharge planning, and hospital operations
  • Excellent strategic thinking, organizational agility, and project management skills
  • Strong analytical thinking, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Proven ability to influence change within complex healthcare organizations using data, problem solving, and change management strategies
  • Ability to balance direct customer ownership with leading and developing a high-performing team
  • Willingness to travel 25-50% of the time

BONUS POINT IF YOU HAVE

  • A RN license or other clinical licensure with significant inpatient hospital experience
  • A graduate degree from one of the following programs: MHA, MPH, MHSA, MBA, or an MS/MSN with a focus in health informatics
  • Lean or Six Sigma training utilizing models like A3, DMAIC, or PDCA
  • Experience implementing healthcare technology or enterprise software solutions
  • Experience leading organizational change initiatives across multidisciplinary hospital teams

WHAT YOU'LL GET

  • Intellectual and emotional satisfaction of solving tough operational problems in healthcare while improving patient access and saving lives!
  • Competitive compensation package that includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options

By providing Neuromuscular business insights, governance support, and operational leadership, the Customer Engagement Business Director helps navigate opportunities and risks while enabling effective decision-making. Through strong partnership and coordination, this role empowers teams to deliver meaningful impact in a fast-paced and evolving healthcare environment.

About the Role

  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to the Vice President, Head of Customer Engagement, providing insights and recommendations that support business performance, organizational effectiveness, and execution excellence.

  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to partner effectively with senior leaders and translate complex concepts into actionable insights.

You’ll get to experience the project in the way it will be consumed by the end users. Location: Remote (Pakistan-based)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Trade & Commercial Principal

Position Overview

The Customer Service Rep (CSR) is the primary point of contact for all service issues on Trade & Commercial (T&C) accounts after an order is placed. The purpose of the role is to take post-sale service and administrative work off the Trade and Commercial sales representatives so they can spend their time selling. At the start of each order, the CSR emails the customer to confirm order details and introduce themselves as the point of contact for any issues going forward. From there, the role is centered on identifying, routing, and driving service issues to resolution — working with Service, Parts Sales, and Sales to get problems fixed and keeping the customer informed along the way. This is a fully remote role working United States Eastern Time business hours, with a defined path to senior service and customer success positions as the CSR builds a track record.

Key Responsibilities

  • Service Request Management
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for service across all Trade & Commercial accounts.
  • Receive service requests from customers directly, or from sales representatives on the customer's behalf.
  • Complete the customer service request form and create the corresponding case in Salesforce.
  • Work with the customer to gather all information needed to action the request correctly the first time.
  • Direct each request to the correct internal department (service, parts, delivery, etc.)
  • Service Tracking & Customer Communication
  • Monitor open service cases to ensure each is actioned by the responsible department in a timely manner.
  • Generate Salesforce reports to track T&C service activity and report results back to management.
  • Run the weekly customer service meeting to prioritize requests, identify issues, and solve problems.
  • Communicate scheduled service dates and details to customers promptly.
  • Gather customer feedback systematically for reporting and improvement purposes.
  • Book Jobs & Confirm Details
  • Send the order confirmation email at the start of each order to confirm order details, introduce yourself as the customer's point of contact for any issues, introduce the delivery coordinator, and communicate current lead times.
  • Perform basic order QAQC review against the standard checklist before booking jobs.
  • Support finance in collecting customer payment via payment link and moving orders off hold.

Qualifications

Strong English fluency, written and spoken — this is the most important requirement for the role. The CSR is the company's primary voice to the customer after the sale and speaks daily with U.S. builders, contractors, and homeowners by phone and email.

Ability to work United States Eastern Time business hours consistently, Monday through Friday.

2+ years in customer service, customer support, customer success, administrative assistant, order management, project coordination, inside sales support, or a similar role.

Highly organised, with the ability to manage a high volume of open orders and service cases without losing track of details.

Comfortable following up persistently with internal departments to hold timelines while maintaining strong working relationships.

Experience with Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace.

Comfortable following documented processes and checklists, and documenting activity accurately.

Building products, millwork, construction, or U.S.-facing B2B account support experience preferred.

Reliable remote work setup required: a quiet, dedicated workspace; high-speed internet with a backup

connection; backup power sufficient to cover outages during scheduled hours; and a computer capable of running CRM and VoIP software.

Greenberg-Larraby, Inc. (GLI) is seeking a Senior Federal Contract Management Consultant to enhance our contracting operations. In this role, you will leverage your extensive experience in federal contract management to provide strategic support and insights that will drive compliance and performance across our federal contracts. Your expertise will play a key role in developing best practices and ensuring that contracts align with GLI’s business objectives.

This position is to start as part- time as needed and can grow into a more full -time opportunity as the business grows and business needs. This is a full remote position.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage the entire lifecycle of federal contracts, from negotiation to execution and compliance review.
  • Develop and implement effective contract management processes, ensuring proper risk assessments and mitigation strategies.
  • Advise and collaborate with internal stakeholders on contract terms, compliance matters, and performance metrics.
  • Conduct thorough contract analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Provide training and mentorship to junior contract staff to build stronger contract management capabilities.
  • Monitor changes in federal regulations and policies and assess their impact on existing contracts.
  • Prepare and present reports to senior management regarding contract status and compliance-related issues.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in federal government contract management supporting IDIQ, Task Order, and Subcontract execution under large federal vehicles (VA, DoD, HHS, DHS preferred).
  • Demonstrated expertise interpreting and enforcing FAR Part 16 (IDIQ), FAR Part 42 (Prime/Sub oversight), and FAR Changes clauses as they apply to Task Orders and subcontractor rights.
  • Expertise in IDIQ task order environments and traditional federal set-aside contracting (WOSB, HUBZone, and 8(a), and a clear understanding of how primes and subcontractors operate differently within each structure.
  • Deep working knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), DFARS where applicable, and the practical application of these regulations to IDIQ task orders, set-aside vehicles (WOSB, HUBZone, 8(a), SDVOSB), and subcontractor management in a prime/sub environment is required.
  • Direct experience working for or advising Prime contractors and subcontractors on execution of awarded Task Orders.
  • Experience with resolving Prime/Subcontractor performance, scope, and execution conflicts.
  • Deep working knowledge of how credentialing, onboarding, and security clearance timelines intersect with contractual obligations on healthcare and professional services contracts.
  • Strong ability to review existing subcontract language and identify risk, leverage points, and enforcement mechanisms.
  • Experience advising small businesses and federal subcontractors and prime positioning.
  • Exceptional analytical and writing skills with the ability to draft clear contractual position statements and executive-level communications.
  • Ability to provide practical, actionable guidance with deep understanding of FAR regulations within large multi-year and multi-billion dollar contracts.

Benefits

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior NetSuite Consultant to join our Managed Services team and serve as a trusted advisor to our growing portfolio of NetSuite customers. This role is ideal for a highly experienced consultant who thrives on solving complex problems, optimizing system usage, and delivering continuous value across multiple engagements.

You will work closely with clients to understand their business needs, troubleshoot issues, enhance their NetSuite configuration, and help them evolve their platform post-implementation.

What You’ll Do

Client Advisory & Support

  • Serve as the primary functional expert for assigned clients, providing ongoing support across Finance, Order Management, Procurement, Inventory, Projects, or other applicable modules.
  • Manage and prioritize a queue of support requests, enhancement needs, and small-scale projects.
  • Conduct regular system reviews and recommend optimization opportunities aligned with client business goals.
  • Troubleshoot issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide timely and accurate resolutions.

Configuration & Solution Delivery

  • Design, configure, and deploy NetSuite enhancements including workflows, forms, saved searches, dashboards, KPIs, and custom records.

Quality & Governance

What We’re Looking For

- Remote-first culture.

raw.description:
Must be located and authorized to work in the US

Role Overview

Statara is seeking a Data Solutions & Engineering leader to guide the design and evolution of client-facing data and analytics solutions while serving as the department head for Data Products & Engineering. This dual mandate combines solution architecture with organizational leadership, bridging business needs with Statara’s Data, Insights, and Activation capabilities.

As department head, this person will assume direct leadership of the Data Products & Engineering team—setting technical direction, managing priorities, and ensuring the reliability and continued evolution of Statara’s core data infrastructure, with particular emphasis on Snowflake and modern cloud data architecture.

On the solutions side, this role partners closely with Business Development, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape scalable solution approaches, support pre-sales technical strategy, and help ensure complex opportunities are well-defined and feasible.

This role is ideal for a strong technologist with leadership instincts—someone who can own a technical function, contribute meaningfully to client conversations, and bring structure to how Statara designs and delivers solutions. You don’t need to have done all of this before, but you should be ready to grow into the full scope.

Key Responsibilities

Department Leadership: Data Products & Engineering

  • Serve as the head of the Data Products & Engineering department, setting vision, priorities, and technical direction
  • Lead, manage, and develop team members, including coaching, mentorship, performance oversight, and capacity planning
  • Own the operational health of Statara’s data infrastructure, including pipeline reliability, platform stability, and data product quality
  • Drive continued evolution of Snowflake-based architecture and modern data workflows across the organization
  • Align engineering and data product priorities with commercial objectives and the broader product roadmap

Solution Architecture & Strategy

  • Lead the technical shaping of client solutions, from initial concept or test through high-level design and delivery planning
  • Translate business objectives into clear data, analytics, and activation approaches that align with Statara’s capabilities
  • Serve as a key technical voice on complex or novel solution designs
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across clients and use cases

Client & Pre-Sales Support

  • Partner with Business Development to scope opportunities, clarify technical requirements, and assess feasibility
  • Participate in client conversations as a technical resource, translating capabilities into clear business value
  • Support the development of technical demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and related materials for key opportunities

Feasibility & Validation

  • Guide data and analytical validation efforts to confirm solution viability, scalability, and expected outcomes
  • Review data structures, assumptions, and analytical outputs to ensure technical soundness
  • Support proof points (e.g., pilots, prototypes, demonstrations) where they strengthen solution confidence

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to align solution designs with platform capabilities and delivery realities
  • Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early to maintain momentum and clarity
  • Bridge commercial intent and technical execution across teams

What Success Looks Like

  • The Data Products & Engineering team operates with clear direction, strong execution, and alignment to company priorities
  • Snowflake-based data infrastructure is reliable, well-maintained, and evolving to meet growing demands
  • Client opportunities are scoped accurately and efficiently, with strong technical grounding
  • Technical solutions are feasible, scalable, and clearly aligned to business value
  • Cross-functional teams are aligned on requirements, risks, and delivery plans
  • The solutions function becomes more repeatable, effective, and scalable over time

Requirements

We’re looking for demonstrated technical depth and sound judgment—earned through real exposure to complex problems—more than a specific career path or title history.

  • Snowflake working experience required. You should have hands-on working knowledge of Snowflake. You don’t need to be a certified architect, but you need to be able to contribute to technical decisions confidently in a Snowflake-centric environment.
  • Experience in solutions engineering, data engineering, analytics, data products, or a related technical role
  • Familiarity with data integration, pipelines, data modeling, and solution architecture concepts
  • Experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics workflows; AWS environment experience is a plus, as is Alteryx
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and executable solution plans
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with complex datasets
  • Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Team leadership experience required—whether through direct management, tech-lead roles, or running cross-functional workstreams. Formal people-management experience is preferred but not the only path.
  • Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, or analytics functions is a strong plus

Plus: Background in data onboarding, identity resolution, audience strategy, martech/adtech, or measurement partnerships. Experience in activation, programmatic, or audience deployment.

Benefits

We believe that a diverse, inclusive staff is a fundamental strength. We’re committed to hiring people of all races, ethnicities, religions, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientations, and gender identities. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and members of untapped groups are strongly encouraged to apply and are welcome on our teams.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and employment. If you require an accommodation to apply for or interview for this position, please let us know (email Gideon at ).

We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION

Including a 401(k) with generous company matching.

100% REMOTE WORKING OPPORTUNITY

Always have been and always will be.

TOP-NOTCH MEDICAL COVERAGE

Domestic-partner inclusive, health, dental, vision, life, cancer coverage, and long-term disability insurance for you and your dependents.

GENEROUS PAID TIME OFF

23 days of PTO per year. We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to use your time off.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE

10 weeks of fully paid time off. All genders qualify equally, and the policy includes adoptions.

raw.description:
Install the Engine. Scale the Machine.

This is not a typical “Head of Ops” role.

This is a scale inflection role.

Emailable has been built founder-led.

Now we’re installing a revenue focused operator to turn aggressive growth into a predictable machine.

If you’ve scaled a chaotic $5M–$15M ARR SaaS and know what breaks between scrappy and scalable, keep reading.

If you want comfort, skip this.

What We’re Building

Emailable powers high-volume senders who live and die by inbox placement.

Tech & SaaS, Ecommerce & Retail, Professional Services, Travel & Hospitality, and Media & Publishing.

When deliverability drops, they bleed revenue.

We’re becoming the verification + deliverability infrastructure layer for that ecosystem.

This role is about making revenue predictable while we scale aggressively.

Requirements

What You Own

You own the revenue engine.

Not meetings.

Not culture slides.

Not “alignment.”

Revenue.

Specifically:

  • Forecast accuracy (±10%)
  • Pipeline discipline
  • Net Revenue Retention
  • Gross churn reduction
  • Enterprise expansion
  • Revenue visibility across the org

You will run:

  • Sales
  • Customer Success
  • RevOps
  • Support

If revenue misses, it’s on you.

If we scale hard, you’re the architect behind it.

What This Role Is Not

  • Not corporate COO
  • Not process theater
  • Not a founder babysitter
  • Not maintenance mode

We want a builder.

Someone who has:

  • Cleaned up messy CRMs
  • Killed fake optimism in forecasts
  • Reduced churn in usage-based SaaS
  • Installed discipline in scrappy teams
  • Worked directly with a driven founder

If you’ve only operated inside polished enterprise orgs, this likely isn’t for you.

What Success Looks Like

By Day 90

  • Clean forecasting system
  • Clear segmentation
  • You running revenue meetings
  • Founder removed from operational noise

By 12 Months

  • Revenue predictable
  • Enterprise motion repeatable
  • NRR strong and stable
  • Internal execution tight

Long-Term

  • Scale toward eight figures
  • Revenue leadership under you installed
  • Infrastructure-level positioning in Media & Publishing

Who Thrives Here

You might be:

  • A VP Revenue at a growth-stage SaaS who’s capped
  • A Head of RevOps already doing CRO-level work
  • A COO at a scrappy martech company
  • A former founder who learned revenue discipline the hard way

You are:

  • Calm under pressure
  • Direct
  • Comfortable challenging a CEO
  • Obsessed with numbers
  • Energized by growth

Benefits

Fully Remote Work

Work from anywhere. We’re a globally distributed team that optimizes for deep work, autonomy, and output, not office hours.

Competitive Compensation

Strong base salary + performance bonus. We pay for talent and expect high ownership in return.

Flexible Time Off

We operate like adults, take time when you need it. No complicated policies, no counting days.

Family-Friendly Policies

We support parents with:

  • Paid parental leave
  • Flexible schedules
  • Real understanding of life outside work

Mental Health & Wellness Support

We encourage sustainable work (not burnout) and provide access to wellness stipends or services to keep you performing at your best.

Annual Home Office & Productivity Budget

Upgrade your setup - monitors, keyboards, software, whatever helps you work better.

Professional Development

Budget for:

  • Courses
  • Certifications
  • Conferences
  • Books

Anything that helps you grow into a future COO-level operator.

Cutting-Edge Tech Stack

Work with a modern toolset and help shape how our internal systems evolve.

High-Trust, No-Bureaucracy Culture

No politics. No red tape.

Just smart people working together to build something meaningful.

Final Filter

If you want stability and incremental growth, this isn’t for you.

If you want to build the revenue machine behind a category-defining infrastructure company, you'll figure out how to get in touch with me.
