raw.description:
Who We Are:

Aspenware empowers mountain resorts and ski areas to deliver the ideal digital guest experience. Our guest-facing e-commerce and registration software is the most capable in the industry and is used by millions of skiers worldwide to process over a billion dollars in annual sales. The resorts we work with trust the innovation and thought leadership that Aspenware provides, and they leverage the operational advantages of our platform to grow their businesses.

We are a talented and high-performing team and welcome the opportunity to learn from one another.

Aspenware makes hiring decisions based on how well candidates align with our Core Values. Aspenware employees are…

  • Dependable: We take ownership. We are accountable and adaptable. We have a can-do attitude and are willing to pivot.
  • Caring: We care about our co-workers and our clients. We are mindful of and inspired by the impact our work has on our communities.
  • Innovative: We are thought leaders who bring creativity and a desire for innovation to everything we do. We are continually improving ourselves and our surroundings.
  • Curious: We challenge default processes while assuming best intent, seeking to understand before judging. We ask good questions to spark learning, better decisions, and smarter outcomes. We make the extra effort to gain a deeper understanding of a situation so we can provide better solutions.

The Role:

The Lead Infosec Engineer will be responsible for leading Aspenware’s existing security program and optimizing it to be even more robust.

You will manage Aspenware’s security operations including IT vendor and MSSP relationships. You will lead efforts to mitigate existing and emerging cybersecurity threats. You will assess, prioritize, and remediate security risks to improve Aspenware’s overall cybersecurity posture.

This is a key role at Aspenware and reports to the Director of Technology Operations & Security. You will work closely with the VP of Technology, other engineering leaders, and business stakeholders to represent the security needs of our platform and hold the enterprise to a rigorous standard of security. Finally, you will collaborate with the Infosec teams at our parent company, Alterra Mountain Co. You will be responsible for sharing strategies, roadmap progress, and incident retrospectives wherever the larger enterprise is impacted.

What You Will Do:

  • Partner with engineering teams and systems architects to ensure the security of our products, cloud infrastructure, and technical platform
  • Be the champion of rigorous security standards when debating resource allocation tradeoffs
  • Improve Aspenware’s AppSec and SDLC security
  • Understand key security attack vectors and protect Aspenware from malicious actors who wish to abuse our system.
  • Manage our security vendor relationships with respect to requirements and technical support
  • Lead the company from its recently earned Type I SOC 2 accreditation through Type 2 accreditation.
  • Assist end users to remediate security issues.
  • Work with external vendors to provide oversight for computers, devices, and networks in a remote work environment
  • Manage and evaluate external vendors to conduct pen testing, endpoint testing, purple team testing, and PCI scans
  • Develop and document network security reference architectures, design patterns, roadmaps, and other architectural artifacts aligned with policies, standards, and industry best practices
  • Work closely with our DevOps team to manage cloud security in Azure:
  • Evaluate Azure cloud and hybrid security services, tools, and appliances in the areas of (but not limited to): intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, packet capture, and quarantine
  • Assess network/cloud security posture and recommend modifications for enhancements, improvements, and mitigations
  • Collaborate with enterprise partners and incident response teams regarding requirements and deployment of security services, tools, and appliances
  • Review access control policies and assist in Identity and Access Management through MS Entra
  • Ensure compliance with NIST CSF or similar frameworks and meet disclosure obligations
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing security processes, policies, and tooling
  • Help cultivate and foster a culture of security across the entire organization by driving awareness and promoting a cohesive narrative around security
  • Perform in-depth investigations when the suspicion of a threat emerges.
  • Coordinate mitigation and remediation plans to address critical risks

Who You Are:

You are passionate about cybersecurity and have a track record in improving the security posture of software engineering organizations. You are a proud advocate of rigorous security standards. You take pride in staying on top of and ahead of information security techniques, standards, and trends. You are a lifelong learner who is constantly educating and challenging yourself to stay ahead of the cybersecurity curve. You thrive in small to mid-size companies where you can take ownership and practice a blend of strategic planning, communication, and individual contribution. You are skilled at communicating with peers, leadership, and clients. You can define and execute on a complex department roadmap and proactively update stakeholders on the status of each of your parallel initiatives.

You Ideally Have:

  • Experience owning the Infosec strategy for SaaS companies, especially in ecommerce
  • Expert knowledge of AppSec, Infrastructure security, access control, and GRC
  • 4+ years of experience in a cybersecurity role within a software development organization
  • 8+ years in technical roles – as a software engineer, information security analyst or similar
  • Masters or bachelor's degree in Information Systems with a focus in cyber security or equivalent experience / certifications
  • Experience with NIST CSF, ISO27001, PCI, SOC2 or similar standards/certifications
  • Experience with OWASP or similar standards.
  • Experience with DevSecOps
  • Direct experience with Azure cloud security
  • Hands-on experience establishing and configuring security controls for Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 components
  • Understanding of DDOS and other infrastructure threats at the edge
  • Strong understanding of security as it relates to CDN, API management, and load balancing technologies
  • Strong understanding of Azure monitoring capabilities
  • Willingness to jump into a complex, fast-paced environment.

What’s In It for You:

  • 4 weeks of PTO to start and increases with seniority
  • 11 paid holidays
  • 6 days of sick time
  • Paid parental leave for both primary and secondary parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • 401k plan with a 5% match
  • Annual all-company ski day
  • Seasonal Ski Pass – Ikon Pass
  • National Park Pass
  • Annual Wellness Stipend
  • Flexible work environment
Salary: $145,000.00-$175,000.00

Position: Sales Development Representative

Status: Contractor

About Us:

Verified First is a booming tech company on a mission to deliver cutting-edge technology transforming how organizations protect their people. As a constant recipient of the "Best Places to Work" award, you can be sure we'll invest in you as both a professional and a person. We're looking for people like you -- ambitious, hard-working, and fun -- to join our team!

Summary:

Verified First is looking for a business-minded Sales Development Representative to initiate meetings for our Account Executives. This position will educate prospective clients on our company, culture, and products to grow business and schedule meetings for our Account Executive Team.

How our Sales Development Representatives spend their time:

  • Make approximately 50 outbound calls per day to set appointments for our Account Executives for pre-employment services;
  • Conduct approximately 50 communication outreach touchpoints via social media and email per day to build rapport for future sales;
  • Set 25 appointments per month for the Account Executives;
  • Initiate communication through outreach via email, LinkedIn, and phone calls to build rapport for future sales;
  • Research prospective clients and pre-call planning;
  • Manage pipeline through CRM Salesforce;
  • Responsible for educating and developing prospects, leading to hand-off to the Account Executive team;
  • Drive attendance for webinars and live seminars, set meetings for conferences;
  • Collaborate with sales and marketing team members on a strategic sales approach;
  • Ensure successful follow-through of the sales cycle by maintaining accurate activity and lead qualification information in the CRM application;
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you bring:

  • Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance;
  • Encourage a direct and positive relationship between the community and the company;
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment;
  • You are a natural problem solver and are focused on creating solutions;
  • You can adapt quickly to a changing environment;
  • You work well independently but understand the importance of teamwork;
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively facilitate and adjust communication styles to the audience.

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required;
  • Working knowledge of G-Suite and Microsoft Office Applications;
  • Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM;
  • Experience working in a call center environment focused on cold calling and closing sales preferred;
  • Experience as a Sales Development Representative for other companies that deliver human resource software solutions preferred.

What we bring:

  • Work-life balance: Enjoy your free time with no weekends, paid holidays, and paid time off starting on your first day;
  • Growth: Continue to learn with continuous education, career pathing, and ongoing training. You won’t stall here, growth is part of our success;
  • Outstanding Culture: In our remote work environment, we prioritize team-building through engaging meetings and events, including town halls, Office Olympics, and culture conversations. These activities are vital for strengthening our connections and embodying our company values.

What are the next steps?

Our Talent Acquisition Specialist will be reviewing resumes. If you are among one of the qualified candidates, you will receive an email or a phone call to schedule an interview.


Verified First is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We expect all team members to have an understanding of, and commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

The pay for this remote position varies based on experience, job responsibilities, and geographical location to comply with state-specific pay regulations.

Own Category Growth, Optimize Performance, and Expand Market Dominance.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Senior Category Growth Manager, Amazon to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar product category, with Amazon as the primary growth channel. This is a high-impact role for a results-driven e-commerce operator who thrives on ownership, accountability, and driving measurable growth through disciplined execution and data-backed decision-making.

While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have driven growth across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to apply that experience within a scaled Amazon ecosystem.

How You’ll Win at Hadley Designs

We believe performance comes from strong systems executed consistently.

Every Category Growth Manager is expected to progress through three stages:

  1. Learn the Playbook – Understand our category strategy, operating standards, and decision frameworks
  2. Apply the Playbook – Execute accurately and consistently to deliver predictable, scalable results
  3. Enhance the Playbook – Improve systems with new ideas and strategies after mastery is demonstrated

This order matters. We value innovation, but only when it is grounded in proven execution. Our playbook exists to help high performers win faster, create leverage, and scale impact — not slow them down.

What You’ll Own

  • End-to-end ownership of category performance, including revenue, margin, pricing, advertising, and inventory
  • Ongoing optimization of product positioning, content, pricing, and promotional strategy
  • Identification and validation of new product and expansion opportunities
  • Lifecycle management of existing products to ensure continued relevance and profitability
  • Inventory and demand planning to support growth while managing cost and risk
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product Operations, Supply Chain, and Design teams

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Learn and execute against Hadley Designs’ category playbook with accuracy and consistency
  • Implement performance improvements within existing strategies
  • Bring forward thoughtful, data-backed ideas to improve or expand the category
  • Take clear ownership of outcomes, consistently raise the performance bar, and be measured on the results you deliver

Apply Now, Own Amazon, and Shape Our Future.

Requirements

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of experience owning product or category growth in e-commerce or marketplaces
  • Proven ability to scale revenue and profitability, either as a brand owner or within a growth team
  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort making decisions from performance data
  • Experience with Amazon Seller Central or the ability to quickly master platform-specific tools
  • Comfortable operating within defined systems before pushing for change
  • Motivated by clear goals, performance benchmarks, and winning as part of a high-performing team
  • Collaborative, accountable, and driven by continuous improvement

Benefits

Why You’ll Thrive Here:

  • Own a multi-million dollar Amazon category with a team that’s got the tools and trust to help you scale.
  • Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins.
  • Cash, tools, and freedom, no leash, just trust.
  • Remote Full Time Work
  • Flexible Schedule
  • Regular Interaction with CEO
  • Established Company doing business for 10+ years
  • Personal Development
  • Autonomy of time and schedule
  • Established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard.

Apply Now

If you’re a hungry, growth-oriented e-commerce operator who values disciplined execution, clear ownership, and improving systems over time, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the next phase of growth at Hadley Designs

P.S: If you don’t hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

🚨 Urgent Hiring — Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process may take up to 4 weeks, but early applicants are strongly encouraged.

Ready to Empower a Growing Team and Shape Our Future?

At Hadley Designs, we believe that learning should be enjoyable, engaging, and screen-free. Millions of parents and teachers trust our beautifully designed, developmentally aligned educational tools to help children grow and thrive. As a fast-growing brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of People Operations & Recruiting to join our team and build the systems that will drive our next phase of growth. If you are passionate about creating scalable people systems, empowering teams, and cultivating a culture that supports both personal and professional growth, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our Mission:
We design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. We create beautifully designed, developmentally sound tools that replace noise and distraction with connection, curiosity, and real learning.

Our Vision:
We aim to build the most trusted children’s brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow. Our products will be so widely used and passed down that generations of children will grow up learning from them and choose them again for their own families.

Role Overview

As the Head of Talent Acquisition & Culture, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top global talent, and you will own the broader people system that talent steps into. You will partner with leadership to design the recruiting engine that consistently delivers strong top-of-funnel for every open role, and you will scale the people systems that hold a remote, contractor-centric organization together as it grows toward $100M and beyond.

This is a leadership-tier role with 1 direct report (the People Operations Specialist) and end-to-end ownership of the talent and people functions. Your weeks will be heavier on recruiting in the near term, live pipelines, structured interviews, test projects, employer brand, and steady on People Operations throughout (onboarding, performance frameworks, contractor renewal, leadership enablement).

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition (the #1 outcome of this role):

• Recruiting Pipeline Management: Source candidates across LinkedIn, job boards, freelancer platforms, and referrals; filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and scorecard alignment.

• Test Project & Interview Operations: Run test projects, review submissions, conduct first-round group interviews, and manage candidate experience end-to-end.

• Sourcing Channel Optimization: Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance; build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.

• Employer Brand & Glassdoor Defense: Monitor and manage Glassdoor reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, protect brand rating.

• Hiring Metrics & Funnel Reporting: Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role; track funnel performance against KPIs.

People Operations:

• People Systems Leadership: Design and implement systems for engaging, onboarding, and retaining talent, align

ed with the company's growth objectives.

• Organizational Design and Capacity Planning: Collaborate with leadership to ensure that the organizational structure and workforce planning meet the evolving needs of the business.

• Performance and Development Frameworks: Establish performance expectations, evaluation frameworks, and development pathways that drive accountability and growth across the organization.

• Talent Experience and Retention: Build a consistent and professional experience for talent that reinforces employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.

• Workforce Insights and Reporting: Provide insights and data-driven recommendations to leadership to guide decision-making and improve workforce effectiveness.

• External Partnerships: Partner with external service providers to enhance and support people operations as necessary.

How Success Is Measured (two bold sub-headers, each with bullets):

Talent Acquisition KPIs:

• Average time to fill open roles: under 45 days.

• Weekly applicant volume per active role: 250+ qualified applicants.

• Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel: 100% completion, on time.

• Completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week: 15+.

• Glassdoor company rating: maintain 4.5+ average across the year.

People Operations KPIs:

• Successful implementation of people systems that directly support the business's ability to scale.

• Strong employee retention rates, with high performance and engagement.

• Improved leadership confidence in people systems, talent readiness, and organizational alignment.

• Predictable, scalable people operations that contribute to the company's growth and success.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are equally comfortable defending the company on Glassdoor as you are building a 90-day onboarding plan. You thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first, contractor-centric environment and have a track record of both filling open roles ahead of timeline and scaling the people systems that retain the talent you bring in.

Talent Acquisition / Recruiting (must-haves):

• 3-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or e-commerce organizations.

• Proven track record of hiring across marketing, ops, Amazon, product, and leadership roles.

• Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and group interviews.

• Familiarity with recruiting tech stacks: LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable, OnlineJobs.ph.

• Comfortable managing hiring systems using Notion, ClickUp, or lightweight ATS tools.

• Strong writing ability: clear job posts, compelling outreach, direct candidate comms.

• Ability to handle 5-10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process.

• Experience defending brand reputation and responding to feedback (e.g. Glassdoor).

• Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics.

People Operations (must-haves):

• 5+ years of progressive HR or people operations experience, with leadership responsibility.

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.

• Direct experience operating contractor-centric or distributed teams.

• Demonstrated success building compliant, scalable people systems.

• Strong understanding of contractor classification, employment law, and risk mitigation.

Benefits

Why Join Hadley Designs?

  • Build the people function as a true growth lever that directly supports execution and scale
  • Partner closely with executive leadership on scaling the organization
  • Operate in a high-ownership, execution-focused environment
  • Remote flexibility with real responsibility and influence
  • Help shape how a modern, fast-growing company builds and retains talent

Apply Today

Apply now and help make learning fun, engaging, and screen-free for families everywhere.

P.S: If you don’t hear from us within two weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Impact: Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand.
  • Culture: Join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a remote role with flexible working hours.
  • Benefits:
    • Remote-first work environment
    • Paid time off and holidays
    • Access to learning resources and professional development
    • Free access to Hadley Designs products
    • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO and CMO
    • Stability from a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Apply Today

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in a growing company that’s shaping the future of learning, apply now to join the Hadley Designs team as our Head of Talent Acquisition & Culture. Help us create a lasting impact on families, educators, and children worldwide.

P.S: If you don’t hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

Real Estate Specialist (Transaction Coordinator, MLS & DocuSign) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Real Estate Specialist to manage transaction coordination, MLS listings, compliance workflows, documentation, and closing operations.

This is not a basic administrative role. You’ll play a critical role in keeping real estate transactions organized and moving smoothly from accepted offer through closing.

You’ll coordinate closely with real estate agents, brokers, buyers and sellers, lenders, escrow officers, title companies, inspectors, and appraisers to ensure deadlines are met, documents are complete, and every transaction remains compliant.

If you have hands-on experience with transaction coordination, MLS platforms, DocuSign, and real estate documentation, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Transaction Coordination – Core Focus

Manage 5–15+ active real estate transactions simultaneously from accepted offer through closing.

You’ll:

  • Maintain transaction checklists and timelines
  • Track milestones and closing requirements
  • Monitor contingency deadlines
  • Coordinate inspections and appraisals
  • Track financing and lender milestones
  • Monitor closing dates and outstanding requirements
  • Follow up proactively on missing documents or approvals
  • Ensure nothing falls through the cracks before closing

Coordinate with:

  • Real estate agents and brokers
  • Buyers and sellers
  • Escrow officers
  • Title companies
  • Lenders
  • Inspectors
  • Appraisers

MLS Listing Management

Create, update, and maintain accurate property listings across MLS platforms.

You’ll:

  • Enter and update listing information
  • Maintain accurate property details, pricing, status, and documentation
  • Ensure listings meet MLS requirements
  • Coordinate listing changes and status updates
  • Support syndication across platforms such as:
    • Zillow
    • Realtor.com
    • Apartments.com
    • Brokerage websites and platforms
  • Track listing activity and provide updates to agents

Contracts, Compliance & Documentation

Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready transaction files.

You’ll manage:

  • Purchase agreements
  • Contracts
  • Disclosures
  • Amendments
  • Addenda
  • Signatures
  • Closing documentation

You’ll also:

  • Review files for missing documents or signatures
  • Maintain transaction compliance checklists
  • Follow brokerage procedures
  • Support compliance with applicable state and MLS requirements
  • Organize files for brokerage reviews and audits

DocuSign & Transaction Management Systems

Manage document workflows using DocuSign and transaction management platforms.

You’ll:

  • Prepare documents for electronic signature
  • Create and manage signature workflows
  • Track outstanding signatures
  • Follow up on incomplete documents
  • Maintain properly executed copies
  • Upload and organize completed documents within transaction files

Experience with platforms such as Dotloop, SkySlope, Brokermint, or similar systems is highly valuable.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Provide proactive and professional communication throughout the transaction lifecycle.

You’ll:

  • Keep buyers, sellers, agents, and brokers informed
  • Coordinate with lenders, title companies, and escrow teams
  • Schedule inspections, appraisals, showings, and closings
  • Communicate upcoming deadlines and requirements
  • Follow up on outstanding items
  • Respond promptly to transaction-related questions
  • Help create a smooth client experience from contract through closing

Real Estate Marketing Support

Support agents with listing-related marketing activities, including:

  • Property flyers
  • Brochures
  • Open house materials
  • Social media assets
  • Listing updates
  • Basic marketing coordination

Reporting & Brokerage Operations

Maintain visibility across the transaction pipeline.

You’ll:

  • Prepare transaction status reports
  • Track active and upcoming closings
  • Monitor commissions and closing timelines
  • Maintain pipeline trackers
  • Support brokerage compliance reviews
  • Maintain organized transaction and operational records

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are extremely organized and deadline-driven
  • Have strong attention to documentation and compliance
  • Can manage multiple active transactions without missing details
  • Follow up proactively rather than waiting for reminders
  • Communicate professionally with clients and real estate professionals
  • Stay calm when deadlines shift or transactions become complicated
  • Understand the importance of accurate real estate documentation
  • Take ownership from contract through closing
  • Work effectively and independently in a remote environment

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Transaction coordination
    • Real estate operations
    • Brokerage support
    • Real estate administration
  • Hands-on experience with MLS platforms
  • Strong experience with DocuSign
  • Experience with transaction management platforms such as:
    • Dotloop
    • SkySlope
    • Brokermint
    • Similar real estate transaction systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Real estate contracts
    • Disclosures
    • Transaction timelines
    • Contingencies
    • Closing workflows
    • Compliance documentation
  • Ability to manage multiple active transactions simultaneously
  • Strong Google Workspace or Microsoft Office skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Active real estate license
  • Transaction Coordinator certification
  • Experience managing 10+ concurrent transactions
  • Residential and/or commercial real estate experience
  • Experience supporting high-volume brokerages
  • Familiarity with:
    • Canva
    • Adobe InDesign
    • Real estate marketing tools
  • Experience supporting:
    • Real estate investment teams
    • Property management operations
    • Multi-agent brokerages

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might:

  • Review active transactions and upcoming deadlines
  • Update transaction checklists and files
  • Follow up on missing documents and signatures
  • Send and monitor DocuSign envelopes
  • Update MLS listings and property statuses
  • Coordinate inspections and appraisals
  • Communicate with lenders, title companies, and escrow officers
  • Update agents and clients on transaction progress
  • Track contingencies and financing milestones
  • Prepare transaction and closing reports
  • Verify documentation before upcoming closings

In short: You ensure every real estate transaction remains organized, compliant, documented, and on schedule from contract through closing.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Zero missed contingency or closing deadlines
  • Accurate and compliant transaction documentation
  • On-time and smooth closings
  • Accurate MLS listings and updates
  • Timely completion of DocuSign workflows
  • Organized and audit-ready transaction files
  • Strong communication with agents, clients, lenders, and vendors
  • High responsiveness and operational reliability

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Own critical parts of the real estate transaction lifecycle
  • Work closely with agents, brokers, lenders, title companies, and clients
  • Build expertise across MLS, compliance, contracts, and closings
  • High-ownership remote environment
  • Clear and structured operational responsibilities
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Transaction Coordinator
    • Brokerage Operations
    • Real Estate Operations Manager
    • Compliance Coordinator / Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have hands-on real estate transaction coordination experience
  • Are confident using MLS platforms and DocuSign
  • Understand contracts, disclosures, contingencies, and closing timelines
  • Can manage multiple transactions without missing deadlines
  • Thrive in organized, detail-heavy, fast-moving environments

This is a strong opportunity to take ownership of real estate transaction operations while working remotely with a growing U.S.-based team.

Retention Marketing & Klaviyo

Technical SEO & Organic Growth

What Makes You a Strong Fit

raw.title: Field GTM Manager, Events and Community
raw.excerpt: Quick highlights• Your goal: Turn the best ecommerce events and communities into 10–15 qualified demos each month.
raw.description:
Quick highlights

  • Your goal: Turn the best ecommerce events and communities into 10–15 qualified demos each month.
  • Your field: Attend or host 3–4 focused events each month across North America.
  • Your audience: Ecommerce founders, operators, Heads of CX and agency leaders.
  • Your ownership: Choose the room, build the guest list, host the experience and turn conversations into pipeline.
  • Location: North America. Remote, with frequent travel across the US and Canada.
  • Reports to: Head of Partnerships. You will also work directly with Richpanel's CEO and sales team.
  • Company: Profitable, Sequoia-backed and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR.
  • Compensation: $130,000–$155,000 base, 20% target bonus, meaningful stock options and benefits.

About Richpanel

Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk.

Brands hire an AI support team that resolves repeat customer questions from start to finish. Their people stay in control of the moments that need judgment.

Richpanel replaces the old helpdesk and the next few support hires. The AI handles order tracking, returns, subscription changes and the repeat work that buries CX teams. Human agents handle the exceptions in the same workspace.

We are profitable, backed by Sequoia and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR. We already serve 3,000+ paying brands.

We have built this with a small team. Your work will be visible in our pipeline and company growth every month.

About the role

The best deals rarely begin at a booth.

They begin at a private dinner, a founder retreat or a small room where the right operators speak honestly about what is not working.

Your job is to put Richpanel in those rooms and turn the right conversations into qualified demos.

You will find the events and communities where our buyers already gather. You will study attendee lists, invite target accounts, work with agency and technology partners, and host experiences people want to attend.

You will also own the commercial result. This is not a brand-awareness or event-logistics role. Your scorecard is qualified demos, pipeline and closed ARR.

What you will own

  • Attend or host 3–4 focused events each month.
  • Generate 10–15 qualified demos each month from the field.
  • Build the annual calendar of dinners, roundtables, retreats and community events.
  • Review attendee lists before we spend. Know which target accounts will be in the room.
  • Pre-book conversations with high-value prospects before each event.
  • Work with agencies, BPOs, technology partners and operator communities on joint events.
  • Own the guest experience from invitation through follow-up.
  • Host dinners, moderate discussions and make thoughtful introductions.
  • Follow up quickly and turn interest into held demos with the right stakeholders.
  • Keep event-sourced pipeline accurate in our CRM.
  • Measure cost per qualified demo, pipeline and closed ARR by event.
  • Build a repeatable playbook that tells us which rooms to return to and which ones to skip.

What counts as a qualified demo

A qualified demo is not a badge scan or a friendly chat.

It means:

  • The company fits Richpanel's target customer profile.
  • The buyer has a real customer-support problem worth solving.
  • A decision-maker or strong internal champion joins the meeting.
  • The buyer has agreed to evaluate Richpanel, not simply receive information.
  • The demo is held and accepted by the sales team.

Requirements

You may be a fit if

  • You have 3+ years in field GTM, events, community, business development, hospitality, brand marketing or a related customer-facing role.
  • You come from an arts, humanities, communications, hospitality, theatre, design or event-production background and know how to create an experience people remember.
  • You are a natural host. You notice who is standing alone, make introductions and help a room come alive.
  • You are also commercial. You have owned a pipeline, meetings or revenue target before.
  • You can show events that produced qualified sales conversations, not just attendance or social reach.
  • You write warm, personal invitations that busy founders want to answer.
  • You can speak with a founder, a Head of CX and an agency owner without sounding scripted.
  • You are organized enough to manage travel, vendors, guest lists, budgets and follow-up without dropping details.
  • You are comfortable travelling several times each month.
  • You take ownership. If an event is not producing meetings, you change the plan.

Strong signals

  • You have worked at an ecommerce brand, agency, BPO, Shopify app or customer-experience company.
  • You already know ecommerce founders, operators, agency leaders or community hosts.
  • You have run private dinners, executive roundtables, retreats or small conferences.
  • You have sold or generated pipeline for B2B SaaS.
  • You have moderated a panel, hosted a podcast, performed on stage or built a community.
  • You can show the exact path from an event to a held demo and closed deal.

This role is not for you if

  • You measure success through registrations, impressions, booth scans or LinkedIn posts.
  • You enjoy planning events but do not want a sales target.

• You wait for people to walk up to you.

  • You prefer large vendor conferences over small, focused rooms.
  • You need a detailed playbook before taking action.
  • You dislike frequent travel or fast follow-up.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Learn Richpanel's product, customers and target buyer.
  • Build a map of the communities, events and partners that reach our best prospects.
  • Create a six-month field calendar with a clear reason for every event.
  • Attend customer demos and learn how buyers describe their problems.
  • Build the first target-account and guest lists.

In your first 60 days

  • Attend or host 3–4 focused events in a month.
  • Generate your first 8–10 qualified demos.
  • Run at least one Richpanel-led dinner or roundtable.
  • Show clean event attribution and fast follow-up in the CRM.
  • Identify the events and communities we should stop funding.

In your first 90 days

  • Consistently generate 10–15 qualified demos each month.
  • Maintain a repeatable rhythm of 3–4 strong events per month.
  • Create measurable pipeline from field programs.
  • Build relationships with the partners and community leaders who can fill future rooms.
  • Own a field playbook that another teammate could follow.

Benefits

Why join Richpanel

  • Your work reaches revenue: You will see the demos, pipeline and customers created by the rooms you build.
  • Real ownership: You will own the field calendar, event choices, guest strategy and budget recommendations.
  • A product worth showing: Richpanel replaces both the old helpdesk and the next few support hires.
  • A strong starting point: Referrals, partners, podcasts and events already create most of our best opportunities.
  • Direct access: You will work closely with the CEO, partnerships and sales.
  • A small team: Good ideas move quickly. There are few layers between a decision and the result.
  • Long-term upside: You receive stock options in a profitable, 8-figure ARR company growing 110% YoY.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $130,000–$155,000 USD, based on experience and location.
  • Target performance bonus: 20% of base salary.
  • Target cash compensation: $156,000–$186,000 USD.
  • Equity: Meaningful stock options with 4-year vesting.
  • Benefits: Paid time off, learning support, company offsites and the tools you need to work remotely.

Your bonus rewards held qualified demos and sourced pipeline. Closed ARR adds upside, but you are not penalized for sales work outside your control.

How we work

  • Customer obsession: Put the buyer's interests first. Never push someone into a meeting that is not useful.
  • Curiosity: Learn how ecommerce operators work and why they buy.
  • Drive: Own the number. Find a way through when the first plan fails.
  • Taste: Create thoughtful experiences, not noisy events.
  • Integrity: Report the real result, even when an event misses.

Interview process

We aim to finish the process within two weeks.

1. Past-results conversation: Walk us through an event or field program you owned. Bring the targets, spend, meetings, pipeline and lessons.

2. Field plan: Build a 30-day plan for reaching ecommerce founders and Heads of CX through 3–4 events.

3. Hosting exercise: Lead a short roundtable discussion and show how you turn it into natural follow-up.

4. Final conversation: Meet the CEO and the people you will work with across partnerships and sales.

How to apply

Send us:

  • The best event or community experience you have created.

• The commercial result it produced.

  • Three ecommerce communities or events you believe Richpanel should enter.
  • A short note on why this role fits the way you work.

If you have a portfolio, event recap, video, podcast, campaign or writing sample, include it. We care more about proof and judgment than a perfect resume.

raw.description:
Quick highlights

  • Your goal: Build partnerships into 30–40% of Richpanel's new ARR.

  • Your focus: The 20–30 agencies, BPOs and CX consultants that can move the market.
  • Your advantage: You bring trusted relationships and know how to turn them into revenue.
  • Location: North America. Remote, with frequent travel across the US and Canada.
  • Reports to: Head of Partnerships. You will work directly with Richpanel's CEO and sales team.
  • Company: Profitable, Sequoia-backed and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR.
  • Compensation: $145,000–$165,000 base, $195,000–$220,000 target cash, stock options and benefits.

About Richpanel

Richpanel is the AI-native helpdesk.

Brands hire an AI support team that resolves repeat customer questions from start to finish. Their people stay in control of the moments that need judgment.

Richpanel replaces the old helpdesk and the next few support hires. The AI handles order tracking, returns, subscription changes and the repeat work that buries CX teams. Human agents handle the exceptions in the same workspace.

We are profitable, backed by Sequoia and growing 110% YoY at 8-figure ARR. We already serve 3,000+ paying brands.

Partners already bring us some of our strongest opportunities. Now we want to turn that advantage into a repeatable revenue channel.

About the role

The best partner managers do not collect logos.

They know which 20 relationships matter. They understand the partner's business, earn trust and create a clear reason to recommend the product.

Your job is to make Richpanel the helpdesk that Shopify agencies, BPOs and CX consultants recommend first.

You will own the full motion. Find the right partners, open the relationship, learn their clients, teach them how Richpanel creates value and work the first deals together.

You will go deep on the product. A development agency, BPO and retention consultant each need a different reason to recommend Richpanel. You will build those talk tracks from customer demos, product knowledge and partner feedback.

You will also own the number. Your primary target is partner-sourced closed ARR. Meetings, events and enablement matter only when they produce revenue.

What you will own

  • Build a named map of the top Shopify agencies, BPOs and CX consultants in North America.
  • Bring existing relationships and open senior conversations quickly.
  • Choose the 20–30 partners that deserve high-touch investment.
  • Recruit, enable and activate those partners against a shared revenue plan.
  • Learn Richpanel's product, customers, competitors and target buyer in depth.
  • Join sales demos until you can run discovery and explain the product yourself.
  • Build partner-specific talk tracks for developers, BPOs, CX consultants and growth agencies.
  • Show each partner how Richpanel creates value for their clients and their own business.
  • Find agencies already working with Richpanel customers and prospects.
  • Build warm introductions through customers, other partners and the Shopify ecosystem.
  • Run joint account mapping, co-selling, dinners, roundtables and focused community events.
  • Help partners qualify opportunities before they reach sales.
  • Stay involved in large deals until the customer closes and launches successfully.
  • Create partner tiers, cadences, enablement and clear rules for high-touch support.
  • Automate onboarding, payouts, deal registration and long-tail communication.
  • Track partner momentum. Re-engage partners before the relationship goes cold.
  • Keep attribution and partner-sourced pipeline accurate in the CRM.
  • Report qualified demos, win rate, closed ARR and partner concentration every month.

What a strong partner looks like

A strong partner does more than sign an agreement.

They:

  • Advise Shopify brands that fit Richpanel's target customer profile.
  • Influence helpdesk, AI, BPO or CX operating decisions.
  • Understand the client's support workflow and unit economics.
  • Can explain why Richpanel fits the client's problem.
  • Bring decision-makers into a qualified sales conversation.
  • Stay involved through evaluation, migration and launch.
  • Produce repeat referrals, not one introduction.

Requirements

You may be a fit if

  • You have 5+ years in partnerships, channel sales, agency growth or ecommerce SaaS.
  • You have owned a closed revenue target and can show the result.
  • You know senior leaders at Shopify agencies, BPOs or CX consultancies.
  • You can name the first 20 partners you would evaluate for Richpanel.
  • You understand how agencies make money and what earns their recommendation.
  • You learn products deeply enough to teach and sell them.
  • You can turn one product into distinct stories for different partner types.
  • You are comfortable joining discovery, demos and commercial calls.
  • You can host a dinner, work a conference and follow up before the flight home.
  • You are analytical. You know which partners create revenue and which create noise.
  • You can build the systems behind the relationships.
  • You move quickly without waiting for a complete playbook.

Strong signals

  • You have led a brand, agency book, ecommerce function or commercial P&L.
  • You have worked at a Shopify app, ecommerce agency, BPO or customer experience company.
  • You have generated meaningful ARR through agency or consultant referrals.
  • Your partners can sell without asking you to join every call.
  • You have built partner tiers, health scores, enablement and referral workflows.
  • You have created joint events that led to qualified opportunities.
  • Customers and partners describe you as commercially sharp and easy to trust.
  • Former managers can verify the numbers you claim.

This role is not for you if

  • You measure success through signed agreements, calls or partner logos.
  • Your network exists only as LinkedIn connections.
  • You prefer broad partner recruitment over deep focus.
  • You need marketing to create every message and asset for you.
  • You avoid product demos or commercial conversations.
  • You wait for partners to send referrals on their own.
  • You report influenced pipeline when the role owns closed ARR.
  • You dislike frequent travel, events or fast follow-up.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Learn Richpanel's product, target customer and competitive position.
  • Join customer demos and listen to how buyers describe their problems.
  • Audit the current partner book, pipeline, tiers and attribution.
  • Build a named list of the first 30 high-potential partners.
  • Define the partner-specific story for agencies, BPOs and CX consultants.

In your first 60 days

  • Open senior conversations with the highest-value partners in your network.
  • Build joint plans with the first 5–8 focus partners.
  • Run tailored enablement for each partner type.
  • Complete the first account-mapping and co-selling sessions.
  • Create a clear weekly view of partner momentum and next actions.

In your first 90 days

  • Generate 10+ qualified partner demos in a month.
  • Close the first partner-sourced ARR against your target.
  • Activate 8–10 focus partners with live opportunities.
  • Run one focused partner or merchant event that creates qualified pipeline.
  • Show which partners deserve more investment and which should move to automation.

In your first 6 months

  • Build 20–30 active, high-value partner relationships.
  • Reach 20+ qualified partner demos each month.
  • Maintain a 50%+ win rate on qualified partner referrals.
  • Put the partner channel on a clear path to 30–40% of new ARR.
  • Build a playbook another partner manager can follow.

Benefits

Why join Richpanel

  • The channel already works: You are scaling proven partner demand, not testing a theory.
  • The number matters: Your work appears directly in demos, pipeline and closed ARR.
  • Real ownership: You choose the partners, motion, cadences and investments.
  • Direct access: You work closely with the CEO, partnerships, sales and product.
  • A product worth learning: Richpanel replaces both the old helpdesk and the next few support hires.
  • A small team: Good ideas move quickly. There are few layers between a decision and the result.
  • Long-term upside: You receive stock options in a profitable, 8-figure ARR company growing 110% YoY.

Compensation

  • Base salary: $145,000–$165,000 USD, based on experience and location.

• Target variable: $50,000–$55,000 USD.

  • Target cash compensation: $195,000–$220,000 USD.
  • Equity: Meaningful stock options with 4-year vesting.
  • Benefits: Paid time off, learning support, company offsites and the tools you need to work remotely.

Variable compensation is based primarily on partner-sourced closed ARR. Qualified pipeline and partner win rate support the scorecard, but activity does not replace revenue.

How we work

  • Customer obsession: Recommend Richpanel only when it is right for the customer.
  • Curiosity: Learn the product, partner business and customer problem in depth.
  • Drive: Own the number and find a path when the first approach fails.
  • Focus: Invest deeply in the few partners that can change the outcome.
  • Integrity: Report the real source, status and result of every opportunity.

Interview process

We aim to finish the process within two weeks.

1. Past-results conversation: Show the partner-sourced ARR you owned and how it was created.

2. Network and product exercise: Choose 10 partners for Richpanel and build the talk track for 2 partner types.

3. Partner meeting: Run a mock first meeting with a Shopify agency or BPO leader.

4. Reference checks: We speak with former managers, peers and partners who can verify your work.

5. Final conversation: Meet the CEO and the people you will work with across partnerships and sales.

How to apply

Tell us:

  • The largest partner-sourced closed ARR target you owned.
  • The result you delivered and how long it took.
  • Five partner organizations you could credibly open a conversation with.
  • One example of a partner you turned from interested into productive.

Do not share confidential information. We care about the quality of your thinking, relationships and proof.

raw.description:
Key Responsibilities

Instructional Design & Content Creation

  • Digital Content Authoring: Design, build, and publish interactive e-learning modules, digital user guides, video walkthroughs, and micro-learning assets from scratch using Articulate 360 (Storyline/Rise) and modern media tools.
  • Curriculum Architecture: Develop scalable training programs tailored to diverse user groups, including HR service desk agents, line managers, and general employees.
  • Asset Maintenance: Continuously update learning materials to align with periodic Workday release cycles, ServiceNow system enhancements, and evolving HR business processes.

Training Needs Analysis & Program Design

  • TNA Execution: Conduct thorough Training Needs Analyses (TNA) across HR functions to identify capability gaps, platform friction points, and proficiency requirements.
  • Learning Strategy: Translate operational gaps into structured, measurable learning paths, curriculum maps, and blended enablement frameworks.
  • Impact Measurement: Establish assessment frameworks and key performance indicators (KPIs) to track user adoption, platform proficiency, and training program effectiveness.

Stakeholder Engagement & Process Enablement

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with HR Technology leads, Process Owners, and Operations Managers to translate technical platform updates into user-friendly learning content.
  • Change Management Support: Act as an enablement partner during system updates, module rollouts, and process changes to ensure seamless transition and operational readiness.
  • Communication & Facilitation: Articulate complex platform workflows clearly and deliver engaging virtual or classroom facilitation to global stakeholders.

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • Professional Tenure: Minimum of 3–5 years of total experience supporting HR technology platforms and training enablement (a hard minimum of 2 years dedicated specifically to ServiceNow and Workday is required).
  • Environment: Proven background operating within a high-volume Shared Services Center (SSC) or Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) environment.
  • Instructional Mastery: Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end program design, TNA, and instructional development.

Technical & Tool Skills

  • HR Platforms: Hands-on functional knowledge of Workday (HCM modules) and ServiceNow (HR Service Delivery / HRSD).
  • Authoring Software: Advanced proficiency in Articulate 360 (Articulate Storyline and Rise) for authoring digital learning content.
  • Media Creation: Familiarity with video editing tools, screen recording software, and digital asset design suites.

Core Competencies

  • Communication: Exceptional, articulate verbal and written English communication skills suitable for engaging global leadership.
  • Stakeholder Management: Verified ability to influence cross-functional business partners, manage competing priorities, and navigate matrixed environments.
  • Self-Direction: Strong sense of ownership with the ability to build structured learning materials from scratch with minimal supervision.

raw.excerpt: Role Purpose This role is the commercial and relationship backbone of iiDENTIFii’s enterprise account portfolio.
raw.description:
Role Purpose

This role is the commercial and relationship backbone of iiDENTIFii’s enterprise account portfolio. It is deliberately dual: you operate as a strategic relationship owner — accountable for the health, retention, and commercial growth of iiDENTIFii’s most important client accounts — while remaining hands-on in the day-to-day: running executive business reviews, managing renewal cycles, and staying close to what each client actually needs. You will lead accounts and build trust at the same time.

This is not a reactive support role. As Senior Partnershipt Manager, you are a proactive, commercially-minded owner who drives measurable revenue outcomes: renewals, expansions, upsells, and new product adoption across an assigned portfolio. You are the client’s internal champion at iiDENTIFii, and iiDENTIFii’s commercial face to the client.

Operating in a technically complex, compliance-heavy environment where clients are navigating FICA, POPIA, and evolving KYC/AML obligations, the Senior Partnership Manager must combine deep industry knowledge, strong executive presence, and a clear understanding of how biometric identity verification creates value in the banking and financial services sector. This role also plays a critical part in bridging client insight back into iiDENTIFii’s product and commercial strategy — ensuring the voice of the customer shapes how the platform evolves.

Role Tasks and Responsibilities

Account Ownership & Client Relationship Management

  • Own and manage a portfolio of iiDENTIFii’s enterprise clients — including tier-1 banks and FSPs — as the primary relationship lead across all levels of the client organisation
  • Build deep, multi-level relationships across client organisations: from operational and implementation teams through to C-suite and procurement decision-makers
  • Develop and maintain structured Account Plans for each client, documenting relationship health, strategic objectives, risk factors, expansion opportunities, and agreed success metrics
  • Conduct regular executive business reviews (EBRs) and operational check-ins, ensuring clients are realising measurable value from iiDENTIFii’s platform and that commitments are consistently met
  • Monitor client health indicators — adoption metrics, support volumes, NPS, contract milestones — and intervene proactively before issues escalate
  • Serve as the internal advocate for the client: representing their priorities, escalating risks with urgency, and coordinating cross-functional responses when needed

Retention, Renewal & Commercial Growth

  • Own the full renewal cycle for assigned accounts: planning, negotiation, and execution, ensuring on-time renewals with strong retention rates
  • Identify, qualify, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the iiDENTIFii product portfolio, including new use cases, volume expansions, and additional integrations
  • Drive new product adoption within existing accounts, working closely with product and solutions teams to align iiDENTIFii’s roadmap with client needs and timelines
  • Manage commercial conversations with confidence: pricing discussions, contract amendments, scope expansions, and multi-year deal structures
  • Maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data for the assigned portfolio in the CRM, providing reliable, decision-ready visibility to leadership
  • Contribute to net revenue retention (NRR) targets by maximising expansion revenue within the existing customer base and minimising churn risk

Strategic Account Planning & Executive Engagement

  • Develop and execute tailored account strategies for key accounts, aligned to both client business objectives and iiDENTIFii’s commercial goals
  • Engage at senior and executive levels within client organisations, positioning iiDENTIFii as a strategic long-term partner — not just a vendor
  • Lead joint business planning sessions with key accounts, aligning on roadmaps, integration priorities, and mutual growth initiatives
  • Identify and navigate political dynamics, stakeholder changes, and competitive threats within client accounts before they become risks
  • Participate in client industry forums, events, and working groups to deepen relationships and build iiDENTIFii’s profile and credibility in the sector

Industry & Domain Expertise

  • Develop and maintain deep understanding of the South African regulatory landscape relevant to clients: FICA, POPIA, SARB directives, FSCA requirements, and NCA obligations
  • Stay current with trends in digital identity, biometric authentication, KYC/AML, and fraud prevention that affect iiDENTIFii’s client industries and shape buying decisions
  • Understand client integration architectures and how iiDENTIFii’s platform fits into their broader technology and compliance stack — well enough to engage credibly without requiring deep engineering expertise
  • Use domain knowledge to position iiDENTIFii solutions with authority in client conversations, translating complex technical and regulatory concepts into clear commercial value
  • Act as an internal resource on South African FSP and enterprise client dynamics, sharing market intelligence with product, sales, and leadership teams to sharpen strategy

Client Onboarding & Implementation Support

  • Lead the commercial and relationship dimension of new client onboarding, ensuring a smooth, confidence-building transition from signed contract to live implementation
  • Coordinate internally across solutions engineering, product, operations, and support to ensure onboarding timelines and client commitments are met without exception
  • Define and agree success criteria with new clients during onboarding, establishing the foundation for ongoing account health measurement and future expansion conversations
  • Ensure clients receive adequate training, enablement, and documentation to adopt iiDENTIFii’s platform confidently and at scale

Voice of the Customer & Internal Collaboration

  • Systematically capture and structure client feedback, feature requests, and pain points — feeding actionable, prioritised insights into product and engineering decision-making
  • Collaborate with the product team to ensure the iiDENTIFii roadmap reflects the real-world needs and priorities of the enterprise client base
  • Partner with marketing on case studies, client testimonials, reference programmes, and co-marketing initiatives that build iiDENTIFii’s market credibility
  • Work closely with the sales team to support expansion into new business units or entities within existing client organisations
  • Provide regular, data-driven portfolio reports to the Head of Enterprise Sales and leadership team, including health scores, renewal forecasts, and expansion pipeline — without being prompted

AI-Augmented Ways of Working

  • Use AI tools as a standard, expected part of the role — a core professional competency, not optional
  • Apply AI to accelerate account research, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, and client communication drafting
  • Use AI to synthesise client feedback, identify portfolio patterns, and surface risks or expansion signals earlier than traditional approaches allow
  • Leverage AI to produce high-quality account plans, EBR materials, and internal reports with speed and precision
  • Stay current with the evolving AI tooling landscape and proactively identify productivity opportunities relevant to client management

Living the iiDENTIFii Culture

  • Champion iiDENTIFii’s culture, values, and purpose in every client interaction and internal collaboration
  • Contribute to building a best-in-class client management function as iiDENTIFii scales
  • Foster a team environment defined by intellectual rigour, psychological safety, collaborative excellence, and a bias for action
  • Actively contribute to iiDENTIFii’s mission: powering innovators in remote biometric digital authentication, globally

Qualifications, Experience and Skills Needed

Experience

  • 7+ years in client management, account management, or customer success in a financial services or fintech environment
  • Demonstrable track record of managing and growing a portfolio of enterprise accounts, including tier-1 banks or major FSPs in South Africa
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder relationships at senior and executive levels, driving trust and commercial outcomes simultaneously
  • Experience owning commercial outcomes end-to-end: renewals, upsells, net revenue retention targets, and expansion pipeline
  • Exposure to the South African financial services ecosystem — banking, insurance, lending, payments, or identity — is strongly advantageous
  • Startup or scaleup experience preferred; comfort operating at pace with evolving processes and limited structure

Domain & Industry Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of the South African regulatory environment: FICA, POPIA, SARB, FSCA, NCA, and related compliance obligations that shape FSP buying behaviour
  • Familiarity with digital identity, KYC/AML, onboarding, and fraud prevention concepts and how they apply to financial services clients
  • Awareness of the South African banking landscape: Big Four (ABSA, Standard Bank, FNB, Nedbank), digital banks (TymeBank, Discovery Bank, Capitec), insurers, and government entities such as SASSA and DHA
  • Ability to engage credibly in technical product conversations — understanding enough to be useful without requiring deep engineering knowledge

Commercial & Analytical Skills

  • Confidence in commercial negotiation, contract discussions, and pricing conversations with senior client stakeholders
  • Strong commercial instincts: able to identify expansion opportunities, recognise buying signals, and manage risk to revenue across a complex portfolio
  • Experience using CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) to manage pipeline, forecast accurately, and document account activity with discipline
  • Data-driven approach to account management: comfortable using metrics, health scores, and dashboards to track portfolio performance and present findings to leadership

Interpersonal & Communication Skills

  • Exceptional communicator — written and verbal — across all levels from operational contacts to C-suite decision-makers
  • Strong executive presence and the confidence to hold strategic, commercially consequential conversations with senior stakeholders
  • High emotional intelligence: able to read room dynamics, navigate conflict, and build trust in complex, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Ability to simplify complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for diverse audiences

Ways of Working

  • Proactive and self-directed: does not wait to be told when a client relationship needs attention — identifies and acts before issues surface
  • Highly organised with the ability to manage a large, complex portfolio without losing detail or momentum
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, scaling startup environment with evolving processes and a high degree of autonomy
  • Collaborative across internal functions: works naturally with product, engineering, solutions, marketing, and leadership to deliver for clients
  • Receptive to feedback, commercially curious, and committed to continuous improvement in both craft and domain knowledge

raw.description:
Job Summary

Mirantis is looking for a commercially driven, deeply technical Product Manager to own AI inference and model serving for k0rdent AI, our control plane for GPU infrastructure and distributed AI workloads. This role sits at the intersection of AI inference, cloud-native infrastructure, distributed systems, and performance engineering. You will define how NeoClouds and Enterprise customers deploy, scale, and operate production inference services while extracting maximum performance from the underlying GPU, network, and storage infrastructure.

This role owns product strategy and solution development for inference products across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. The scope includes serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, workload placement, autoscaling, routing, lifecycle management, observability, and full-stack performance optimization. This person will define how customers run production model-serving workloads at scale while improving latency, throughput, utilization, reliability, cost, and operational control.

The ideal candidate has experience with high-performance infrastructure products and understands how production systems behave under real-world load. They should be comfortable reasoning across the full stack, identifying performance bottlenecks, evaluating system design trade-offs, and translating technical insight into clear product requirements, architecture direction, and customer-facing solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Own product strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle for inference and model serving, including serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, autoscaling, routing, KV cache management, and the related observability
  • Lead deep technical discovery with NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and enterprise platform teams, and translate findings into prioritized requirements and architecture direction
  • Partner with engineering on system design trade-offs across runtime integration, GPU scheduling, network, storage, and serving topology, including disaggregated serving and multi-model serving
  • Define positioning grounded in measurable outcomes: latency distributions, throughput per GPU, utilization, tail reliability, and cost per tokens
  • Drive go-to-market execution: pricing and packaging, reference architectures, sizing guides, PoC playbooks, and direct engagement with customers, analysts, and ecosystem partners
  • 7+ years in product management, technical product management, or a senior technical role owning AI/ML and inference product(s)
  • Strong understanding of production AI inference, including model serving, serverless execution, dedicated endpoints, autoscaling, routing, workload placement, observability, and reliability
  • Proven capability to reason about performance trade-offs across GPU, network, storage, orchestration, and runtime layers, and to translate low-level technical capability into business value such as TTFT, throughput per GPU, and TCO
  • Working knowledge of modern inference runtimes (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Dynamo, Triton) and the optimization patterns that matter in production: continuous batching, KV cache management, cold starts, prefill versus decode, disaggregated serving, and multi-model serving
  • Credibility with engineering leaders and infrastructure operators, including comfort in production architecture reviews and technical commercial conversations with platform engineering buyers

Why you’ll love Mirantis

  • Build the token factory foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
  • Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
  • Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
  • Professional development and training.
  • Attend conferences and working groups.
  • Customized workstation (macOS, Windows).
  • A competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan and stock options.

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. raw.excerpt: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks!
raw.description:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

As a Microsoft Purview Sr. Consultant, you will help our customers protect, govern and ensure compliance on the use of their data. Working alongside senior Purview experts, you will translate business, legal and regulatory requirements into concrete Microsoft Purview configurations across Microsoft 365 and Azure. You will spend most of your time hands-on: configuring sensitivity labels, deploying Data Loss Prevention policies, setting up retention rules and tuning classifications, always with a strong focus on user experience and operational stability.

This role is a natural next step for security consultants with 3 – 4 years of IT security experience who want to specialize in Microsoft data security and compliance. You will grow through customer engagements, coaching from more senior colleagues and continuous learning, with a clear path towards a Purview Expert role.

You will contribute to Microsoft Purview projects across the full delivery lifecycle. Your day-to-day tasks will typically include:

  • Classification & Labelling: Configure and deploy sensitivity labels, sensitive information types and auto-labelling policies in Microsoft Purview, based on designs prepared with other consultants. Support pilot rollouts and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Implement DLP policies across Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints. Tune rules to balance protection with usability, analyse alerts and reduce false positives.
  • Data Retention & Records Management: Build retention labels and policies that map to the customer’s legal, regulatory and contractual obligations. Assist in disposition reviews and lifecycle management scenarios.
  • Insider Risk & Compliance Monitoring: Assist in configuring Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance and audit / eDiscovery use cases, and help operational teams interpret the resulting signals.
  • Integration with the Microsoft Security Stack: Configure the interactions between Purview and Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and Microsoft Entra, contributing to an end-to-end Defender XDR data protection story.
  • Documentation & Handover: Produce clear design documents, configuration baselines, runbooks and knowledge transfer material so that customer teams can operate the solution after go-live.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with customer stakeholders (IT, Security, Legal, DPO, Compliance) as well as internal NVISO teams to gather requirements, validate designs and demo solutions.
  • Support & Continuous Improvement: Provide second-line support on Purview deployments, be familiar8 with the Microsoft Purview roadmap and related technologies and continuously improve the delivery approach and reusable material.

Requirements

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states.
  • 3 – 4 years of professional experience in IT security, including exposure to Microsoft 365. Azure or cloud security in general is considered a plus.
  • Purviewhands-on experience with at least one year working with Microsoft Purview capabilities: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, eDiscovery, Insider Risk and/or Data Governance; in a customer or enterprise environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Technical skills

  • Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 platform (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams) and a good understanding of the Microsoft Entra identity model.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft Purview portal and its core solutions: Information Protection, Data Loss Prevention, Data Lifecycle Management and Records Management.
  • Understanding ofhow Purview integrates with Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Endpoint and the broader Defender XDR ecosystem.
  • Basic scripting skills in PowerShell (Exchange Online, Security & Compliance) to automate deployment, reporting and troubleshooting tasks.
  • Regulatory & Domain Knowledge
  • Working knowledge of data protection regulations such as GDPR, and awareness of frameworks like NIS2, ISO/IEC 27001 and DORA and how they translate into data protection controls.
  • Ability to translate legal and business requirements into concrete data classification, DLP and retention rules.

Soft skills

  • Strong communicationskills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and to write clear documentation.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • A consulting mindset: curious, structured, customer-focused and comfortable working on several engagements in parallel.

Benefits

What do we offer

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • A training budget of 10.000€ and 10 days every 2 years.
  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc).
  • An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun!

WE’RE LOOKING FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!
