raw.title: Global Technical Manager - Business Assurance, Certification
raw.excerpt: Minimum eligibility criteria: This is a senior global certification leadership role.
raw.description:
Minimum eligibility criteria:
This is a senior global certification leadership role. Appointment requires demonstrable, current and substantial experience in management system certification at global or multi-region level, including leadership of geographically dispersed, culturally diverse technical teams and accountability for accreditation strategy, technical decision-making and network-wide implementation.

The role reports to the Global Head of Certification (QHSE), Product & Quality Management for Business Assurance.

Please note that this is a fully remote role, and we only welcome applications from candidates who have a valid work permit in their country of residence.

Role purpose:

The Global Technical Manager provides senior technical and accreditation leadership for the Business Assurance Certification business. The role sets, maintains and enforces the technical framework, accreditation strategy, certification policies and governance controls that determine consistent, compliant and commercially effective service delivery across the SGS affiliate network.

The post-holder is expected to operate with the credibility, judgement and seniority required to influence senior business leaders, represent SGS with Accreditation Bodies and make final technical decisions where certification, accreditation, impartiality, integrity or business risk issues arise.

Primary accountabilities:

  • Set the global technical and accreditation strategy for Business Assurance Certification in consultation with the Global Head of Certification and relevant business leadership.
  • Lead, develop and manage global technical and accreditation functions, including direct and indirect leadership of product, technical and accreditation specialists located across multiple countries and regions.
  • Define, approve and enforce global certification policies, technical requirements, accreditation controls and operating standards across the affiliate network.
  • Provide authoritative technical direction to the certification business, including final decision-making where disputes, interpretation issues or material compliance risks arise.
  • Manage strategic relationships with global and local Accreditation Bodies, ensuring confidence in SGS integrity, competence, impartiality, governance and global operating model.
  • Ensure technical and accreditation requirements are implemented in a way that protects compliance, supports consistent service delivery and enables commercially viable operations.
  • Represent the Business Assurance Division externally, and act as delegate for the Global Head of Certification where required.
  • Lead investigations and corrective action governance for material technical, accreditation or integrity failures within affiliates, ensuring effective restoration of compliant independent operation.
  • Drive simplification, digitalisation and continuous improvement of technical processes, systems and delivery models, including future audit delivery approaches and technical review efficiencies.

Specific responsibilities:

  • Provide senior-level contribution to the strategic direction of the Business Assurance Certification business.
  • Act as lead advisor to business management on certification, accreditation, impartiality, technical governance, integrity and business risk matters.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of core accreditation and certification requirements, including ISO/IEC 17021-1, ISO/IEC 17065 where applicable, IAF, EA and other relevant regional or product-specific requirements.
  • Interpret external accreditation requirements and convert them into clear, practical and enforceable internal policies, procedures, tools and controls.
  • Oversee global accreditation activities and support affiliates in maintaining, extending or defending local accreditations.
  • Directly or indirectly support key Accreditation Body relationships and activities, including UKAS, ANAB, SAS and other local or product-specific Accreditation Bodies as applicable.
  • Resolve technical, accreditation, operational and commercial conflicts across the network, balancing compliance, impartiality and business impact.
  • Work with operations, sales, IT, product groups and regional teams to define core systems and ensure adoption of global best practice.
  • Identify improvement opportunities in procedures, systems, governance controls, competence frameworks and technical support processes.
  • Support development of new certification products and services by ensuring technical feasibility, accreditation alignment and operational readiness.
  • Maintain responsibility for technical direction and leadership of specific certification products or schemes as required.

Required profile - essential:

  • Graduate-level qualification or equivalent professional experience in a relevant technical, scientific, engineering, management system, commercial or governance discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant certification and/or accreditation experience, including significant management system certification experience in an accredited third-party certification environment.
  • Substantial global or multi-region certification leadership experience. Experience limited to a single country, single affiliate, consultancy-only environment or narrow technical discipline is not sufficient for this role.
  • Proven experience leading geographically dispersed and culturally diverse technical teams, including direct or matrix management of senior specialists across multiple countries or regions.
  • Demonstrable track record of setting or enforcing technical policy, accreditation strategy, certification governance controls or network-wide requirements at regional or global level.
  • Strong technical command of management system certification and accreditation requirements, including impartiality, competence, audit delivery, certification decision-making and Accreditation Body expectations.
  • Credibility to engage with senior business leaders, Accreditation Bodies and technical experts, and to make well-reasoned decisions under pressure where there is commercial, accreditation or integrity risk.
  • Commercial judgement sufficient to ensure compliant service delivery remains efficient, scalable and aligned with business objectives.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex technical requirements clearly to senior leaders and operational teams.

Required skills and behaviours:

  • Senior technical leadership and sound professional judgement.
  • Strategic outlook with the ability to translate technical and accreditation requirements into practical business solutions.
  • High-impact influencing skills across a matrix organisation, including the ability to challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching and performance management capability for senior technical professionals.
  • Ability to manage conflict, competing priorities and ambiguity without compromising certification integrity or accreditation compliance.
  • Change management capability, including leading adoption of new systems, procedures and working practices across a global network.
  • Innovation mindset and ability to challenge established practice where simplification, digitalisation or risk reduction is possible.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level briefing, external representation and clear policy drafting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and willingness to work with digital certification, workflow and reporting tools.
  • Flexibility to travel internationally as required by Accreditation Body, leadership, governance or network support activities.

Desirable experience:

  • Senior role within SGS, another global Certification Body or an Accreditation Body.
  • Lead auditor, technical reviewer, certification decision-maker, trainer or scheme manager experience in accredited third-party management system certification.
  • Experience implementing significant change to certification systems, competence frameworks, technical review processes, audit delivery models or accreditation governance.
  • Experience leading or supporting digital transformation, automation, remote audit delivery or AI-enabled process improvement within certification or conformity assessment.
  • Additional languages relevant to the SGS network or Accreditation Body engagement.

Why SGS?

  • Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
  • Flexible schedule and hybrid/remote model.
  • SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
  • Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
  • Benefits platform.

Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,600 employees operate a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

At SGS, we have an open corporate and international culture. We offer a dynamic work environment in a leading global company. Our high professional standards and our sustainability approach guarantee you a future-oriented work environment. We invest in our employees for the long term and are committed to supporting your development within the company. Our business principles include: Integrity, Health, Safety & Environment, Quality & Professionalism, Respect, Sustainability, and Leadership.

description: Head of International AlliancesThe CompanyTurbineOne builds AI-powered software for frontline operators working in defense, national security, and tactical environments.

raw.title: Head of International Alliances
raw.excerpt: Head of International AlliancesThe CompanyTurbineOne builds AI-powered software for frontline operators working in defense, national security, and tactical environments.
raw.description:
Head of International Alliances

The Company

TurbineOne builds AI-powered software for frontline operators working in defense, national security, and tactical environments. Our Frontline Perception System (FPS) helps teams process and act on critical information in low-connectivity, real-world conditions.

We’re a fast-moving DefenseTech startup building products that matter in mission-critical environments.

Team: Growth
Location: Europe / Remote
Reports to: Chief Growth Officer

The Role

As Head of International Alliances, you will lead TurbineOne's strategy for identifying, evaluating, building, onboarding, enabling, managing, and scaling strategic partnerships that accelerate growth across Europe and MENA. You'll be responsible for expanding our ecosystem across defense primes, technology companies, systems integrators, OEMs, and venture-backed DefenseTech innovators. This is a leadership role that directly supports revenue generation by improving market access, strengthening customer propositions, enabling joint pursuits, and helping TurbineOne's sales organization create, advance, and win opportunities.

To excel in this role, you should thrive on analyzing markets, decoding competitive dynamics, identifying mutually beneficial alliances, and turning those relationships into measurable commercial outcomes. You will work side-by-side with Sales and collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Government Relations, and Executive Leadership. Prior experience as a direct, quota-carrying salesperson is required so that you understand firsthand what sales teams need from a partner, how complex defense opportunities progress, and how partnerships should contribute to pipeline and revenue without competing with Sales for customer ownership.

Primary Responsibilities

Partnership Program

  • Launch & Scale: Own the end-to-end development and execution of TurbineOne's international partnership program, with primary responsibility for Europe and MENA.

  • Target High-Value Alliances: Identify and secure technology, channel, integration, distribution, manufacturing, and strategic partners that improve customer access, market reach, technical differentiation, or probability of win.

  • Develop the European and MENA Ecosystem: Forge deep, long-term relationships with European defense primes, systems integrators, OEMs, emerging DefenseTech companies, and relevant government and NATO innovation organizations.

  • Team with Sales: Build partnerships around specific commercial objectives, target accounts, programs, and pursuits that help TurbineOne sales teams create qualified pipeline, gain customer access, and improve win probability.

  • Build for the Future: Establish scalable partnership processes, systems, governance, playbooks, and operating models that can support future regional or sector-focused partner managers.

Partnership Diligence

  • Lead and coordinate commercial and strategic diligence for prospective European and MENA partnerships.

  • Evaluate partner capabilities, reputation, technical fit, financial stability, genuine customer access, competitive positioning, incentives, and execution risk.

  • Coordinate cross-functional technical, operational, legal, contracts, security, compliance, financial, and business reviews prior to partnership approval.

  • Develop Go/No-Go recommendations and executive decision briefings that clearly articulate the expected strategic and commercial value of each partnership.

Commercial Execution

  • Structure and negotiate partnership frameworks including:

    • NDAs

    • Teaming Agreements

    • Memorandums of Understanding

    • Reseller Agreements

    • Distribution Agreements

    • Strategic Alliance Agreements

  • Work with contracts, legal, and outside counsel (as appropriate) to document, review, and finalize agreements.

  • Build repeatable partnership playbooks, onboarding processes, governance models, sales-facing rules of engagement, and success metrics tied to pipeline, customer access, and partner performance.

Market Expansion

  • Expand TurbineOne's reach across priority European and MENA defense markets through strategic partnerships that complement the direct sales motion.

  • Identify priority countries, defense programs, customer segments, and opportunities where a partner can materially accelerate access, contracting, integration, or adoption.

  • Develop partner enablement strategies that empower partners to accurately position, support, and grow TurbineOne while preserving clear customer and opportunity ownership with the sales organization.

  • Establish and progress joint go-to-market planning, co-selling, demonstrations, capture efforts, proposals, and marketing initiatives tied to specific customers, programs, and measurable commercial outcomes.

In a Typical Week You Will

  • Evaluate and Initiate Strategic Alliances: Meet with a prospective European or MENA prime, integrator, or OEM to assess whether the relationship can materially improve TurbineOne’s access, positioning, or probability of success on priority opportunities.

  • Execute Due Diligence: Validate market access, customer networks, reputation, competitive conflicts, incentives, and operational execution capabilities before recommending investment in a partner.

  • Build Executive Recommendations: Synthesize diligence into structured Go/No-Go recommendations that define strategic rationale, commercial objectives, risks, and expected contribution to TurbineOne’s growth.

  • Negotiate Key Agreements: Review, structure, and negotiate NDAs, teaming agreements, reseller agreements, and other partnership frameworks that protect IP, customer relationships, and TurbineOne’s long-term commercial interests.

  • Align with Engineering: Partner cross-functionally with Engineering to evaluate integration feasibility with partner platforms.

  • Build and Execute Joint Go-to-Market Plans: Work with Sales to develop partner-supported account, pursuit, co-selling, demonstration, and capture plans that accelerate qualified pipeline and improve win probability.

  • Manage Ongoing Partner Relationships: Lead periodic business reviews with active partners to assess joint pipeline, account activity, enablement, performance, risks, and future milestones.

  • Support Sales and Proposal Efforts: Work with Sales, Capture, and Proposal teams to coordinate partner participation in customer engagements and craft compelling multi-company proposals.

  • Communicate with Executive Leadership: Review the prospective and active partnership portfolio, including partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, performance, risks, and strategic opportunities across Europe.

  • Establish Best Practices: Create and curate partner competencies, playbooks, onboarding materials, enablement assets, and rules of engagement that make the partnership function easy for Sales to use.

Desired Experience

  • 10+ years in Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, Alliance Management, Sales, or related commercial leadership roles, with meaningful responsibility for international markets.

  • Significant experience within the defense, national security, aerospace, or DefenseTech ecosystem; direct DefenseTech experience is strongly preferred over general enterprise technology experience.

  • Prior experience as a direct, quota-carrying salesperson with personal responsibility for pipeline development, opportunity management, forecasting, and revenue attainment.

  • Demonstrated understanding of how complex defense technology sales progress from initial customer engagement through evaluation, capture, procurement, negotiation, and award.

  • Demonstrated success identifying, activating, building, and managing strategic partnerships that contribute to measurable pipeline, revenue, customer access, or program wins.

  • Meaningful experience working across European defense markets (MENA a plus), including familiarity with defense primes, systems integrators, OEMs, national procurement environments, and industry teaming structures.

  • Strong understanding of international business development, distribution models, channel partnerships, joint go-to-market motions, and how partners should support—not replace—the direct sales organization.

  • Experience structuring and reviewing U.S. and international commercial agreements such as NDAs, teaming agreements, reseller agreements, distribution agreements, and strategic alliance agreements.

  • Working knowledge of ITAR, export controls, intellectual property considerations, government contracting compliance, and other requirements relevant to international defense business.

Expectations

  • You're a builder who takes the initiative to create scalable partnership programs from the ground up in markets where TurbineOne may not yet have an established presence.

  • You think strategically but execute tactically, and you evaluate partnerships by their ability to create measurable commercial value rather than activity alone.

  • You have personally carried a quota and understand what Sales needs from a partner, while remaining disciplined about role clarity and customer ownership.

  • You naturally connect people, organizations, and ideas into mutually beneficial partnerships—and know how to distinguish genuine market access from superficial relationships.

  • You collaborate across Sales, technical, legal, and business teams to solve complex problems and support customer outcomes.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity, extensive European and MENA travel, startup speed, and continuously improving processes as TurbineOne scales internationally.

  • Above all, you're motivated by helping deliver transformative AI capabilities into the hands of those operating on the front lines.

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What You'll Do

  • Execute high-volume outbound prospecting daily (80–150+ activities/day) via cold calls, cold email, LinkedIn, and SMS
  • Use HubSpot to manage daily outreach including call tasks, email cadences, and follow-ups
  • Build and manage targeted prospect lists using Apollo and Clay, aligned with Bluelight's ideal customer profile
  • Run structured multi-touch outbound sequences in Instantly to engage prospects and drive responses
  • Leverage ZoomInfo to research accounts, identify key decision-makers, and enrich prospect data
  • Write and send high-converting outbound emails and LinkedIn messages with strong personalization and clear calls-to-action
  • Initiate outbound conversations with confidence, clearly communicating Bluelight's value proposition within the first few seconds
  • Qualify prospects based on defined criteria (budget, authority, need, timeline) and identify real sales opportunities
  • Handle objections effectively and position Bluelight as a solution to prospects' software and technology needs
  • Book qualified discovery calls for Account Executives and ensure strong show rates through proper follow-up

  • Continuously improve messaging and outreach strategies based on results

What We're Looking For

  • Required: Hands-on experience with Apollo, Clay, Instantly, and ZoomInfo (candidates without direct working experience in all four of these tools will not be considered)

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers confidently
  • Familiarity with CRM software such as Salesforce or similar platforms

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with a customer service-oriented approach
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and improve outreach performance

What Success Looks Like

  • Hitting daily activity and meeting targets
  • Generating high-quality, qualified meetings
  • Building a consistent and predictable pipeline
  • Clearly communicating Bluelight's value

Company Benefits

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. An overview of this role

As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.

Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.

You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.

What you'll do

Strategy & Prioritization

  • Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.
  • Map how work flows across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?
  • Manage intake of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.
  • Prioritize strategically against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.

Adoption & Change Management

  • Reimagine, not just automate. Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.
  • Drive adoption and change management together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise AI to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.
  • Build and bridge the Champion network in your function. Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.

Hands-On Building & Agent Operations

  • Build AI agents using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.
  • Author and iterate on skills files that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.
  • Configure MCP servers and tools, giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.
  • Own your function's fleet of agents. Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.
  • Expect to rebuild. AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.

What you'll bring

Business & Strategic

  • Deep knowledge of your function's operations. You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.
  • Strategic prioritization skills. You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.
  • A product management mindset. You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.
  • Strong communication and influence. You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.
  • Cross-functional instincts. You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.
  • Experience building peer networks or communities of practice. You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.

Hands-On & Technical

  • Comfortable building with AI tools. You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.
  • Ready to learn fast. Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.
  • Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.
  • Ability to map data flows - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.

About the team

You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology & AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As the Director of Paid Advertising, you are the leader of your pod, a hybrid of senior individual contributor, people manager, and product leader for your channel of expertise (Creative, Paid Media, Organic Search, or Social) within the division. Reporting to the Managing Director, you own two things above all else: the people on your pod, and the quality of the work that pod produces.

This is a player-coach role, not a purely operational one. You are arguably the best generalist on your pod, not necessarily the single best specialist at any one skill, but the person who has demonstrated enough judgment, craft, and consistency that the team's trust in you is real and earned, not assumed by title. You lead from the front, capable of sitting in a client meeting and explaining the strategy directly, and capable of getting your hands dirty on coverage and doing the work at an exemplary standard. You ask nothing of your team that you wouldn't do yourself, and couldn't do at least as well.

You protect your pod from unreasonable client pressure while holding the team to a high, non-negotiable bar of excellence. You are on the roadmap to Managing Director, using this role to build the people leadership, product judgment, and cross-functional fluency that role demands, while staying closer to the craft than an MD typically can.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a pod of Strategists within [Channel], including direct ownership of hiring, onboarding, and day-to-day people leadership.
  • Build and maintain individual development plans, coaching cadences, and mentorship for every member of the pod.
  • Own team retention through positive team sentiment, psychological safety, and clear paths for growth.
  • Drive performance management using the ARC framework; deliver timely, direct feedback and clear raise and promotion recommendations.
  • Oversee capacity planning and staffing alignment across the pod as client books shift.
  • Facilitate ongoing training and channel knowledge-sharing (platform updates, new tactics, competitive shifts).
  • Provide executive-level oversight for client accounts within the pod, including direct, hands-on support for the pod's most complex or highest-priority accounts.
  • Act as Account Director on a select number of the pod's single channel clients.
  • Act as the primary point of escalation for client concerns within the channel, offering strategic guidance and resolving one-off issues directly.
  • Support high-level strategy development, performance narrative, and internal audit or QA requests to ensure the pod's delivery is consistently exceptional.
  • Track client churn and churn trends within the pod's book of business, and intervene early where risk signals appear.
  • Quality: own product quality for the pod through consistent, accountable QA processes, catching errors before they become client-facing or revenue-impacting.
  • Critical Error Management: intercept potential overspends and other revenue-impacting mistakes before they reach the client, and maintain rigorous adherence to planned spend and budget accuracy targets.
  • MCC & Business Manager Hygiene: maintain clean MCC and Business Manager structures across the pod's book of business to prevent access issues, suspensions, and disapprovals.
  • DI & MMT Quality: partner with the Data Intelligence team to ensure MMT implementation accuracy and drive ongoing optimization.
  • Systems fluency: demonstrate full working knowledge of the Power Circuit and the nova ecosystem, adapt to evolving internal processes, and contribute to operational excellence.
  • Innovation: lead channel-specific product development through structured innovation efforts, knowledge-sharing, and regular brainstorms; run and centralize the learnings from betas and tests.
  • New Tool & Partner Vetting: evaluate new tools, platforms, and partners, and build the business case for adoption where they strengthen the pod's product offering.
  • Partnership: collaborate with the Service Lead and key platform partners to stay ahead of channel trends and emerging opportunities.
  • AI adoption: leverage AI tools to optimize workflows, surface insights, improve performance, and model that adoption for the pod.
  • Ensure daily use of our proprietary technology (Omega and nova), Team Pulse cadence at 100%, and Power Circuit (our diagnostic system) compliance across managed pod.
  • Case Studies: develop compelling case studies from the pod's work, and surface strong candidates to the Managing Director for the division's outcome-narrative pipeline.
  • Audits & Pitches — contribute to new business efforts by supporting audits, pitches, and prospective client opportunity identification
  • Service Expansion — identify and act on service expansion opportunities within the pod's existing book of business
  • Drive pod growth by leading recruitment efforts for [Channel] conducting interviews, assessing channel-specific skill, and building the business case for new hires.
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements

  • 7-8 years of digital marketing experience, with 5+ years in an agency setting.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on, expert-level experience in [Channel: Creative / Paid Media / Organic Search / Social].
  • 5+ years of experience managing a team, including performance management and development planning.
  • Demonstrated judgment and credibility that has earned the trust of a team of specialists.
  • Expert knowledge of how the channel functions within the broader marketing funnel and business strategy.

Other skills required

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including direct client-facing presence.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Self-motivated, with a strong desire to build something — both a team and a product — rather than simply maintain it.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and high emotional intelligence.
  • Strong work ethic and the ability to learn quickly and independently.
  • Genuine interest in a long-term relationship with a growing company.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Client Book Revenue per Employee $10K
  • Pod Client Retention (bi-annual) 95%
  • Pod Service Contribution Margin 60%
  • Pod Revenue per Employee (RPE) Average $27K/ Person
  • Team Retention (direct reports) 95%

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Effectively manage the pod to create a positive team member experience aligned with company objectives.
  • Deliver a top-tier, consistently excellent product for clients through the pod's work.
  • Own the growth and evolution of the channel's product, not just its day-to-day delivery.
  • Oversee the growth and retention of both the team and its clients.

    • Offices in Buenos Aires, Medellin, San Diego, New York, Atlanta

raw.title: Data Architect
raw.excerpt: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance.
raw.description:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Data Architect will define and lead the enterprise data architecture for Cordance Commerce, with primary responsibility for unifying reporting platforms, data models, and analytics capabilities across Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who can turn fragmented operational data and customer-specific reporting into a scalable, governed, and reliable data platform.

The role partners closely with Database Administrators, Business Intelligence professionals, Engineering, Product, Finance, Customer Success, and business leaders. The Data Architect will establish a practical migration strategy that separates analytical workloads from transactional systems, protects product performance, preserves critical customer reporting, and enables a trusted source of data across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the target-state data architecture and roadmap for a unified reporting and analytics platform across Cordance Commerce products.
  • Assess current transactional databases, data pipelines, reporting tools, standard BI reports, and customer-specific reports; document dependencies, duplication, performance risks, and migration constraints.
  • Define a shared enterprise data model, canonical business definitions, master-data strategy, and system-of-record ownership for core entities such as customer, item, store, employee, transaction, inventory, donation, processing, and e-commerce activity.
  • Design the separation of transactional and analytical workloads using fit-for-purpose patterns such as a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse; evaluate platforms including Snowflake and recommend the appropriate solution based on scale, security, cost, operability, and business needs.
  • Create the phased migration strategy for consolidating reporting from Solutions, Secure Retail, Upright, and Pearl Dive while maintaining business continuity and customer commitments.
  • Develop patterns and standards for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, semantic models, APIs, data quality, lineage, metadata, retention, archival, and observability.
  • Partner with BI professionals to rationalize the Solutions standard report catalog and reduce the support burden created by hundreds of Secure Retail customer-specific reports through reusable datasets, governed self-service analytics, and configurable reporting patterns.
  • Guide DBAs and engineering teams on database architecture, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL modernization, replication or change-data-capture patterns, performance isolation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness.
  • Establish data governance practices covering data ownership, access controls, privacy, security, auditability, quality thresholds, and change management.
  • Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations; translate findings into actionable designs, sequencing, estimates, risks, and investment recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to delivery teams, review implementation designs, and ensure new product capabilities align with the target architecture instead of creating additional data silos.
  • Enable trusted enterprise dashboards and cross-product reporting that support operational, customer, financial, and executive decision-making.

Competencies:

  • Enterprise Data Architecture: Converts complex, fragmented data estates into pragmatic target-state architectures and phased roadmaps.
  • Technical Depth: Designs modern warehouses or lakehouses, dimensional and relational models, pipelines, semantic layers, and reporting platforms.
  • Business Translation: Connects architecture decisions to customer value, product performance, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Data Governance: Establishes clear ownership, definitions, lineage, quality, security, and lifecycle controls without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Migration Leadership: Plans incremental transitions that protect customer reporting and production stability while retiring duplication and technical debt.
  • Influence and Collaboration: Builds alignment across DBAs, BI, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.
  • Ownership: Drives decisions through implementation, manages ambiguity, and remains accountable for platform adoption and results.
  • AI and Analytics Readiness: Designs governed, reusable data foundations suitable for advanced analytics and AI-enabled workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, database architecture, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, including 3+ years in a data architecture or senior technical leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, or analytical platforms and migrating data from multiple operational systems.
  • Strong data-modeling expertise across conceptual, logical, and physical models, including dimensional modeling and normalized transactional designs.
  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL, relational databases, ETL/ELT patterns, orchestration, data quality, metadata, lineage, and BI semantic models.
  • Experience separating reporting workloads from high-volume transactional systems and designing for performance, resilience, scalability, and cost control.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms and modern data integration patterns, including APIs, replication, and change data capture.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present architecture decisions and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL, including modernization or migration initiatives.
  • Experience consolidating reporting platforms following acquisitions or across a multi-product SaaS portfolio.
  • Experience rationalizing large libraries of standard and customer-specific reports and enabling governed self-service analytics.
  • Familiarity with retail, point-of-sale, inventory, e-commerce, donation, or thrift/resale data domains.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, security, role-based access, audit, retention, and compliance practices.
  • Experience enabling machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI use cases through governed enterprise data products.
  • Relevant cloud, Snowflake, data-management, or architecture certification is a plus.

What We Offer

  • Work with a mission-driven team building impactful software solutions for the thrift and resale industry.
  • Opportunity to shape shared technology capabilities across a growing portfolio of commerce products.
  • Collaborative culture that values innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and transparency.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities for career growth.

Success Measurements

Architecture & Roadmap

  • Completes an agreed current-state assessment and target-state architecture covering all Commerce reporting platforms and critical data domains.
  • Delivers an approved, sequenced migration roadmap with clear dependencies, costs, risks, and ownership.

Unified Data & Reporting

  • Establishes common business definitions and governed data models that are adopted by reporting and product teams.
  • Reduces duplicated datasets and one-off reporting solutions while preserving priority customer capabilities.
  • Enables reliable cross-product operational and executive reporting from trusted data sources.

Performance, Reliability & Quality

  • Moves resource-intensive analytics away from transactional systems where appropriate and measurably reduces reporting-related production impact.
  • Implements measurable data-quality, freshness, lineage, observability, and recovery standards for critical data products.

Migration & Adoption

  • Achieves agreed migration milestones without material disruption to customer reporting or operational workflows.
  • Builds strong adoption among DBAs, BI professionals, engineers, business users, and product stakeholders.

Governance & Cost Effectiveness

  • Establishes accountable data ownership and access controls for priority domains.
  • Provides transparent platform usage and cost metrics and demonstrates progress toward a scalable, supportable reporting model.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

raw.description:
THE POSITION

Insurance Call Center Representative

QuoteWizard by LendingTree is currently looking to grow our Warm Transfer Verification program. Our service centers around making outbound calls as well as taking inbound calls from customers who have recently applied online to receive free insurance quotes. After asking a series of qualifying questions, we match and connect callers with an Insurance Company that will attempt to provide them with an insurance policy best suited for their needs. Ideal candidates must be able to handle a large number of calls while maintaining enthusiasm and professionalism, are able to work in a scripted environment, and truly enjoy achieving targets and consistently setting their sights on raising the bar.

To be a great fit for the job, you:

  • Are extremely comfortable with and motivated to meet and exceed goals and metrics.
  • Possess strong listening skills, a professional telephone demeanor and the ability to skillfully assist callers in a fast-paced call center environment.
  • Driven to be thorough in your performance related to the scripts, processes, and systems pertinent to overall workflow and quality expectations.
  • Receptive to and quick to implement constructive feedback and possess strong desire to continuously improve.

PREFFERED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • High School Diploma required
  • Possess 2-3 years of Call Center (either Customer Service and/or Sales) experience
  • Prior experience in outbound telemarketing preferred
  • Prior experience with an aggressive, commission based, compensation structure is preferred
  • Must be detail oriented
  • Must possess good work ethics and integrity
  • Must have excellent attendance
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule
  • Must be technically savvy and able to launch their QuoteWizard career from an at home work environment as this role is 100% remote for the forseeable future. Selected candidates will conduct training on their OWN audio/video capable laptop/desktop. Mobile devices, tablets, etc. are not acceptable for training. Once you graduate from our weeklong virtual Training, you will be issued QuoteWizard Equipment via mail.

COMPENSATION

  • $17.00/hourly with an uncapped monthly commission potential (Typical commission payouts average between $500 & $3000 monthly). Commission Eligibility begins after 30 days on the team.
  • $500 sign-on bonus at 30 days of hire
  • $100 monthly attendance bonus after 60 days of hire
  • Access to additional compensation, organizational benefits & performance incentives
  • Additional benefits upon conversion to a LendingTree employee: stock options, 401K, paid time off, cash bonuses, tuition reimbursement, work/life balance support initiatives.

ABOUT LENDINGTREE

LendingTree is the nation’s leading online lending marketplace. We connect consumers with multiple lenders so they can easily compare options and find the right fit — from mortgages and personal loans to credit, savings, and insurance products.

Our founder, Doug Lebda, started LendingTree in 1996 after his own frustrating house-hunting experience. What began as a simple idea to make loan shopping easier has grown into a platform that empowers millions of people to make smarter financial decisions every day.

About QuoteWizardQuoteWizard, a division of LendingTree, helps consumers and insurance agents connect through a seamless online marketplace. More than 40 million people have used QuoteWizard to compare quotes and save on insurance. By combining technology, transparency, and expertise. QuoteWizard makes shopping for insurance simple and accessible — empowering people to make confident choices about their coverage. When you think of insurance, think QuoteWizard.

What else you should know:

  • We’re a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: TREE).
  • We’ve welcomed several other companies into the LendingTree family to expand our reach and capabilities.
  • We’ve built the LendingTree app and My LendingTree dashboard to give consumers tools to manage and monitor their financial health.
  • We’re also committed to giving back — through philanthropic programs, volunteer opportunities, and partnerships that strengthen the communities where we live and work.

OUR CULTURE

We’re a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that values curiosity, creativity, and getting things done together. Our teammates are some of the brightest, most driven people you’ll meet — and we celebrate innovation, inclusion, and ownership. At LendingTree, you’ll find an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives make us stronger. We believe in working hard and supporting one another — with the flexibility and trust that help you thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re proud to offer generous benefits, wellness programs, and time-off policies designed to help you recharge, stay healthy, and bring your best self to work every day. And yes — we still have fun doing it (our “GSD – Get Stuff Done” award is a fan favorite!)

Come grow with us, make an impact, and be part of a company that truly cares about its people and its community.

LendingTree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion (or creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status.

ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL — we're the tech-powered growth partner for ecommerce brands, running 12+ owned fulfillment centers across the US, Canada, the UK, and Europe so our merchants can stress less and grow more.

About the role

ShipMonk is looking for a strategic transportation leader to own our entire transportation network: small parcel, freight (LTL and FTL), air, and ocean.

The goal is lower cost, faster delivery, and a better customer experience, all at once. You'll get there through sharp network design, disciplined carrier negotiation, and a team you build and develop to run the details so you can stay focused on the strategy.

You'll own the cost side of our Virtual Carrier Network, strategic carrier negotiation, guide the technical side (rate shopping algorithms, auditing, and rate reconciliation), and connect both to the revenue side (the services and pricing we offer customers and the initiatives that grow them).

What you'll do

  • Set the multi-year strategy for ShipMonk's transportation network, then translate it into quarterly plans your team can execute.
  • Design the carrier network to lower cost and cut delivery time, and redesign it as volume, lanes, and rates change.
  • Build and develop a high-performing team. Set clear priorities, raise their capability, and give them room to own the day-to-day.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives across Product, Revenue, and Operations to strengthen supply chain efficiency and the overall cost structure.
  • Negotiate contracts with national and regional carriers, and agreements with LTL, ocean, and air freight carriers.
  • Partner with Product to keep the VCN tool selecting the right carrier and optimizing for lowest cost and highest performance.
  • Own carrier relationships and act as the final point of escalation for vendor issues.
  • Audit carrier invoices and performance, and turn the findings into sharper strategy.
  • Build the business analyses that surface opportunities to improve internal and external vendor processes.
  • Apply zone skipping, pre-sorting, drop-off rates, delivery to regional sorting centers or DDUs, and similar techniques to keep lowering transportation cost.
  • Work with Revenue and Operations to shape an optimized delivery offering for ShipMonk's customers.

What you'll bring

  • A strategic thinker who can zoom out to a multi-year plan and zoom into a single surcharge line, then move between the two quickly.
  • A proven people leader who has built, developed, and retained strong teams.
  • Excellent communication and analytical skills.
  • Direct experience with high-volume small parcel shipping across multiple carriers.
  • A deep understanding of carrier invoicing, including surcharges and accessorials.
  • Experience with regional carriers and multiple modes of transportation to reach the best rates.
  • Experience with zone skipping and postal sharing programs.
  • The ability to prioritize and lead multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • At least 3 years in a similar senior leadership position.
  • At least 5 years in a similar environment.

About ShipMonk

ShipMonk isn't just a 3PL; we're a growth partner for merchants. We provide cutting-edge technology and a network of owned and operated fulfillment centers that empower high-growth ecommerce and DTC brands to stress less and grow more. With over 2,500 employees across five countries, we're on a mission to revolutionize fulfillment by providing everything from the fastest click-to-delivery and real-time inventory to custom solutions—all with a merchant-first mindset.

Why ShipMonk?

We believe in building for the long term, and our success is powered by five key differentiators that help us become true partners to our merchants.

  • Global Fulfillment Network: Our 12+ owned and operated fulfillment centers span the US, Canada, the U.K., and Mainland Europe. We never outsource, ensuring quality and consistency.
    ● Proprietary Technology: We've eliminated the need for tribal knowledge with our AI-powered platform. It provides a real-time, unified view of inventory and orders, giving our merchants the control and visibility they need to succeed.
    ● Unrivaled Support: We provide hands-on, "mom and pop" support with a global reach. Our dedicated teams are on-site at every fulfillment center, ready to jump into action.
    ● Transparent Pricing: We believe in honest, long-term partnerships. Our all- inclusive pricing means predictable costs, with no hidden fees or surprises.
    ● Committed to the Future: We invest over $10 million annually in research and development to ensure our technology and services continually evolve, helping merchants plant roots with a partner who is here to stay.

Our Core Values

Our values are the heart of our culture. We're looking for individuals who embody these principles every day.

  • Merchant-first: We handle the logistics so our merchants can focus on what they do best—growing their business.
  • People make ShipMonk: We believe in our team and invest in our people.
  • Own it: We take ownership of our work, our mistakes, and our successes.
  • Get sh*t done: We're a fast-paced, high-growth company that values action and results.
  • Change the score: We challenge the status quo, constantly innovating and improving.

ShipMonk is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. Your work will focus on optimizing decision-making and adaptive behavior across integrated data modalities such as text, images and audio to deliver enhanced intelligence, robust performance, and domain-specific capabilities for real-world challenges. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks.

You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified frameworks that integrate multiple modalities.

  • Design and build reinforcement learning infrastructure that supports scalable, distributed training across multimodal systems while maintaining efficiency and reliability.

  • Develop and refine reward modeling strategies that improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create and curate multimodal simulation environments and datasets to support robust training, evaluation, and benchmarking of reinforcement learning systems.

  • Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

  • Publish research findings in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

Requirements

  • A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field is required; a PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, or a closely related discipline is preferred, along with a strong track record of AI research and publications in top-tier conferences.

  • Proven experience running large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online RL settings, with demonstrated impact on domain-specific decision-making and measurable improvements in policy performance.

  • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization methods applied to vision and multimodal learning problems, with a focus on improving policy stability, exploration, and sample efficiency in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

  • Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to solve core RL challenges in multimodal and vision tasks, such as sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation tradeoffs, and training instability, along with experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on algorithmic improvements to advance agent performance.

  • Proven track record of research publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.description:
Хто ми?

SupportYourApp — міжнародна Intelligent Support-as-a-Service компанія, що надає послуги аутсорсингу бізнес-процесів для інших ІТ-компаній по всьому світу (технічна та користувацька підтримка, сервіси для покращення досвіду користувачів) вже протягом 15 років. Наразі в нашій міжнародній команді 1500+ фахівців.

Ми надаємо послуги по всьому світу, підтримуючи клієнтів 60-ма мовами, співпрацюємо з такими лідерами як MasterCard, Calm та MacPaw, маємо міжнародні хаби, а також розробляємо такі інноваційні продукти, як Quidget — щоб робити клієнтський досвід кращим кожного дня.

Про позицію:

Ми шукаємо досвідченого DevOps інженера до нашої Infrastructure команди, що допоможе підтримувати інфраструктуру на найвищому рівні. Маєш від 3 років досвіду у системному чи мережевому адмініструванні та бажаєш стати частиною міжнародної команди? Тоді ми чекаємо саме на тебе!

Звучить цікаво? Далі більше 💛

Що ти будеш робити:

  • Будувати, підтримувати та оптимізувати CI/CD pipelines для веб-продуктів, сайтів та внутрішніх сервісів компанії у Jenkins та GitLab CI/CD;
  • Підтримувати поступову міграцію deployment processes з Jenkins на GitLab CI;
  • Забезпечувати стабільні, repeatable та predictable deployments з rollback-механізмами і мінімальною кількістю manual steps;
  • Налаштовувати та підтримувати Docker-based runtime environments для web applications та сервісів;
  • Стандартизувати Docker, docker-compose, deployment scripts та runtime-конфігурації, щоб рішення не потребували регулярного rework;
  • Адмініструвати Linux-сервери у production-середовищі: налаштування, patch management, troubleshooting, performance analysis;
  • Автоматизовувати infrastructure setup, configuration management та maintenance-процеси через Ansible і Bash;
  • Підтримувати web infrastructure: Nginx, SSL/TLS, reverse proxy, routing, Cloudflare, DNS, caching та базові security rules;
  • Налаштовувати, підтримувати та покращувати monitoring, logging та alerting для production systems;
  • Аналізувати deployment failures та production incidents, визначати root cause і пропонувати preventive actions;
  • Підтримувати backup/restore, monitoring та базове troubleshooting для MySQL/PostgreSQL;
  • Забезпечення reliability та stability production systems;
  • Аналіз production incidents, проведення root cause analysis та впровадження preventive actions;
  • Участь у post-incident reviews та підготовка технічних висновків після інцидентів;
  • Впроваджувати та підтримувати security practices для Linux і web infrastructure: hardening, контроль доступів, оновлення, закриття вразливостей;
  • Документувати інфраструктурні рішення, deployment workflows, конфігурації та важливі зміни;
  • Узгоджувати production changes з командою, попереджати про ризики та не вносити критичні зміни без прозорої комунікації;
  • Проактивно виявляти слабкі місця в deployment, infrastructure та application architecture, які можуть призвести до нестабільності, та ініціювати їх усунення.

Важливо та потрібно:

  • 3+ роки досвіду адміністрування Linux-серверів у production-середовищі (systemd, networking, firewall, SSH, логування, storage, processes, performance troubleshooting);
  • Впевнене розуміння мережевих технологій і протоколів (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS, WebSockets, reverse proxy, routing, діагностика мережевих проблем);
  • Практичний досвід роботи з Docker та docker-compose (runtime-середовища, networking, volumes, дебаг, оптимізація);
  • Досвід побудови та підтримки CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD), включно з автоматизованим деплоєм, rollback та мінімізацією downtime;
  • Досвід автоматизації інфраструктури та конфігурацій (Ansible);
  • Досвід роботи з Nginx (reverse proxy, SSL, routing, деплой веб-застосунків);
  • Розуміння принципів SRE: reliability, observability, incident response, root cause analysis;
  • Досвід роботи з моніторингом та логуванням (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Promtail, Sentry або аналоги) та побудови alerting-стратегій;
  • Базовий/середній досвід адміністрування MySQL/PostgreSQL (backup/restore, моніторинг, troubleshooting);
  • Розуміння best practices безпеки Linux та веб-інфраструктури (hardening, access control, SSL/TLS, patching, vulnerability handling);
  • Сильні навички troubleshooting: локалізація проблем, root cause analysis, preventive actions;
  • Самостійність та ownership у роботі з інфраструктурними задачами end-to-end;
  • Англійська мова на рівні Intermediate (В1) та вище.

Буде перевагою:

  • Досвід роботи з AWS, GCP або іншими хмарними платформами;
  • Досвід роботи з Cloudflare та Terraform;
  • Підтримка великої кількості production-хостів і модернізація legacy infrastructure;
  • Розуміння high-availability рішень (Keepalived, replication, failover);
  • Досвід роботи з Redis, RabbitMQ, Memcached;
  • Розуміння MySQL/PostgreSQL replication;
  • Базові навички Python або Go;
  • Досвід адміністрування WordPress/headless WordPress;
  • Досвід проведення post-incident reviews та RCA.

Чому класно бути частиною нашої команди:

  • Надання послуг у бізнес-години;
  • Унікальні артпростори в Києві на ст. м. Васильківська (відчуй атмосферу! ) або можливість співпраці у віддаленому форматі;
  • Комунікація, заснована на довірі, та відсутність трекерів активності;
  • Гармонія між проєктною завантаженістю та особистим часом, а також – внутрішня медична політика;
  • Креативна спільнота і культура, орієнтована на людей та взаємний фідбек;
  • Привабливі винагороди за запрошення друзів;
  • Конкурентна компенсація в USD;
  • Оплачуваний онбординг і доступ до корпоративної бібліотеки.

*Пункти, перелічені в цьому розділі, можуть відрізнятися залежно від умов вашого договору. Певні пільги та умови зазвичай застосовуються до працівників; незалежні підрядники можуть не мати права на всі ці пільги. Конкретні умови, включаючи компенсацію, пільги та умови співпраці, будуть чітко визначені у вашому договорі, якщо його буде підписано.

Можеш дізнатися більше про компанію та культуру, відвідавши офіційний сайт SupportYourApp та її соціальні сторінки Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn.

Якщо тобі цікаві інфраструктура, автоматизація та стабільна робота систем, а також подобається розбиратися в інцидентах і покращувати надійність сервісів — будемо раді твоєму резюме.

Маєш ідеального кандидата на прикметі? Рекомендуй друга та отримуй винагороду!

Ми дотримуємося принципів рівного ставлення до кандидатів і забороняємо дискримінацію за будь-якими ознаками, що захищаються законом.

Ваші персональні дані оброблятимуться відповідно до Повідомлення про обробку персональних даних кандидатів SupportYourApp (Candidate Privacy Notice).
